jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Hybrid role - 2 days on site in London Wall Place.

Position at Logitech:

Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Team And Role:

A leader in sustainability, Logitech designs software-enabled hardware solutions in pursuit of our mission to extend human potential in work and play.

Our Creative & Design team delivers award-winning design and creative excellence.

The Associate Creative Director is a strategically minded, hands-on creative who works closely with the Creative Director to raise the ambition, originality and effectiveness of Logitech’s creative output.

You will help shape how the brand shows up across campaigns, content and experiences, bringing together strong ideas, distinctive art direction and exceptional craft. You will be equally comfortable developing a big idea, shaping a visual world, challenging and refining creative, and getting into the detail to make the work better.

Working across Logitech Personal Workspace (PWS) and with teams across the business, you will help create attention grabbing work and creative experiences that are culturally relevant, strategically grounded and distinctly Logitech.

Your Contribution:

Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech.

In this role you will:

Shape creative ideas: Develop original, strategically grounded ideas that bring Logitech’s brand, products and business ambitions to life. Push beyond the expected to create work that is distinctive, relevant and memorable.
Raise the creative bar: Work closely with the Creative Director to elevate the quality, ambition and originality of our creative output. Bring a critical eye to ideas and execution, knowing when to challenge, refine or push further.
Be hands-on: Concept, art direct and design integrated creative across campaigns, content, social, digital, photography, film and other brand experiences. Remain close to the work from initial idea through to final execution.
Build compelling creative worlds: Develop strong visual and conceptual systems that give campaigns a distinctive point of view and create consistency across multiple channels and markets.
Champion the brand: Help evolve and strengthen Logitech’s creative expression, ensuring work feels unmistakably Logitech while remaining fresh, contemporary and culturally relevant.
Collaboration is key: Partner with writers, designers, strategists, marketers, producers and external creative partners to turn ambitious ideas into exceptional work. Help create an environment where the best idea wins.
Present and influence: Clearly articulate creative thinking, concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners are what helps Logitech succeed. So build confidence in the work and use feedback to make it stronger.
Put the consumer first: Develop a strong understanding of consumer mindsets, behaviours and cultural context to create work that is meaningful, useful and engaging.
Bring craft and detail: Have a deep appreciation for design, typography, photography, film, motion, digital and emerging forms of creative expression. Know that great ideas only become great work through great execution.
Stay ahead of what’s next: Keep close to culture, creativity, technology, AI and emerging creative tools. Experiment with new ways of working and look for opportunities to make our work more innovative and effective.
Champion creative ambition: Bring energy, curiosity and a restless desire to make work that stands out, earns attention and moves the brand forward.

Key Qualifications:

For this position we are looking for you to demonstrate:

10+ years of experience with a standout portfolio of original, strategically grounded, big idea driven advertising, brand and engagement work. B2C experience is essential, with B2B experience a huge plus.
A strong track record of developing and delivering high-quality integrated creative across campaigns, film/video, social, digital, photography, experiential and non-traditional media.
Exceptional conceptual and art direction skills, with the ability to turn strategic challenges into simple, compelling and distinctive creative ideas.
A high level of craft and a strong understanding of how to take an idea from initial thought through to polished final execution.
Experience working with and influencing senior creative, marketing and cross-functional stakeholders, with the ability to clearly articulate creative strategy, narrative and ideas.
Strong presentation skills and the confidence to champion creative thinking while remaining open to feedback and collaboration.
Experience working across complex, multi-channel and global brand environments, with an understanding of how to create work that can scale without losing its creative impact.
Deep production and post-production knowledge across video, CG, photography, print and digital, with the ability to collaborate effectively with production partners and specialists.
A genuine passion for advertising, design, popular culture, technology and emerging creative trends.
A strong interest in AI and emerging creative technologies, and an appetite for exploring how they can unlock better ideas, faster workflows and new forms of creative expression.
A collaborative, curious and generous creative partner who can build strong relationships across disciplines and bring people with them.
A restless drive to create truly outstanding, culturally resonant work.
A steady demeanour, strong emotional intelligence and the ability to give and receive feedback in a way that makes the work stronger — without ego.

We’re a fast-growing app growth agency based in Central London, helping clients across the UK, Europe and the Americas launch, grow and scale their apps. We combine creative and data-driven thinking to deliver measurable growth.

We’re looking for an innovative, performance-driven Lead Creative to help shape our growing Creative Studio.

About the Role

This role is ideal for an experienced Senior Creative, Designer or Creative Strategist ready for greater ownership. You’ll lead creative strategy, quality and innovation, combining strategic thinking with hands-on creative work to deliver high-quality, performance-focused work aligned with client goals.

You’ll work closely with internal teams, clients and freelance creatives to help build a high-performing and scalable Creative Studio. The role is approximately 70% creative leadership and strategy, and 30% creative production, depending on business needs.

Own the creative vision, strategy and quality across client accounts.
Develop creative strategies for Paid Media campaigns, using performance data and audience insights to drive recommendations.
Review, critique and approve creative work to ensure it meets quality, brand and performance standards.
Lead creative testing and optimisation to improve campaign performance.
Direct and manage freelance creative partners, providing clear briefs, feedback and creative direction.
Act as a key strategic and creative contact for clients, presenting concepts, strategies and recommendations.
Lead creative workshops, ideation sessions and strategic discussions.
Develop creative concepts from initial insight through to execution.
Contribute to creative production and design when required.
Drive innovation through AI and emerging creative technologies.
Develop scalable creative systems, templates, asset libraries and workflows.
Stay up to date with creative trends, platform developments and best practices.
Support pitches, proposals and wider business growth opportunities.
Work with the wider team to improve creative processes, efficiency and client outcomes.

Requirements

5+ years’ experience, or equivalent senior-level expertise, in a creative, performance marketing or digital agency, including experience in a senior creative role. Experience developing and leading creative strategy across Paid Media campaigns, including Meta, Google and other performance channels.
Strong understanding of performance marketing, creative testing and conversion-focused creative.
Strong understanding of ASO, mobile growth and the relationship between creative and app performance.
Ability to turn performance data, audience insights and campaign learnings into creative recommendations.
Experience presenting creative strategies and concepts to clients and senior stakeholders.
Experience managing freelancers and external creative partners.
Strong visual design skills and the ability to create high-quality Paid Media and ASO assets when required.
Experience developing creative concepts from insight through to execution.
Experience building creative systems, templates and production workflows.

Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.

Flexible hybrid working in London
Collaborative and supportive working environment
Regular team socials, lunches and activity days
Direct access to senior management
Company bonus scheme
Monthly mobile phone contribution of up to £30
Personal development and training budget
Employee recognition programme and monthly prizes
25 days' holiday, increasing after two years
Employee Assistance Programme
Virtual GP and mental health support
Company pension and life insurance
Private health insurance
Summer Fridays
Work-from-abroad scheme
Paid sabbaticals after five years
Office refreshments and amenities
Cycle to Work and Electric Car Scheme

This is a great opportunity for a Senior Creative, Designer or Creative Strategist who wants greater ownership and influence, while playing a key role in shaping a growing Creative Studio.
If you’re passionate about creative strategy, performance, design and innovation, and enjoy combining creativity with data-driven thinking, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Creative Lead – DTC & Performance Creative
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Creative Lead – DTC & Performance Creative based in Germany.

This is a high-ownership creative leadership role within a fast-growing direct-to-consumer environment where creative is a key driver of customer acquisition.

You’ll oversee the creative engine across agencies and internal teams, ensuring ideas move efficiently from research and briefing through production, QA, testing, and iteration.

The role combines creative leadership, agency management, performance marketing, and data-driven decision-making.

You’ll collaborate closely with strategists, editors, designers, and art direction to consistently raise the quality and effectiveness of paid social creative.

Performance data will guide your decisions, with metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS, CVR, and revenue informing what to improve and test next.

You’ll also build scalable systems, workflows, and reporting practices that turn creative learnings into repeatable processes.

This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced performance creative professional who wants meaningful ownership over both creative output and business growth.

Accountabilities

Own the end-to-end creative production process across multiple external creative agencies and an internal team, managing priorities, quality, delivery, reviews, and performance.
Lead agency relationships, including running biweekly calls, setting expectations, reviewing output, and holding partners accountable for execution and results.
Develop approximately 10 creative briefs per week using customer research, audience insights, competitive intelligence, and performance data.
Oversee and quality-check scripts, static concepts, UGC ideas, hooks, video edits, landing-page concepts, and supporting research.
Provide clear, actionable creative feedback to strategists, editors, designers, creators, copywriters, and agency partners.
Manage creative workflows and production tracking through Notion or comparable project-management systems.
Research winning advertisements, customer reviews, competitors, audience pain points, offers, hooks, and emerging creative patterns to inform new concepts.
Analyze creative performance and identify which concepts, formats, messages, and executions are working and which opportunities should be tested next.
Translate weekly performance insights into clear team updates, actionable recommendations, and repeatable creative systems.
Collaborate across creative and performance functions to continuously improve production efficiency, creative quality, and campaign results.

Requirements

4+ years of experience in performance creative, creative production, agency management, or a closely related field.
Proven experience managing creative agencies, vendors, creators, editors, designers, copywriters, or other creative partners.
Strong experience briefing and developing paid social creative, particularly for Meta and TikTok.
Strong understanding of DTC/eCommerce, UGC, performance creative, and direct-response marketing principles.
Demonstrated ability to connect creative decisions and production output to performance metrics and broader business outcomes.
Comfortable managing creative workflows using Notion or similar project and collaboration tools.
Excellent written communication skills, particularly for asynchronous collaboration, briefing, feedback, and reporting.
Highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of outcomes in a fast-moving environment.
Strong analytical and research skills, with the ability to turn customer insights and performance data into actionable creative recommendations.
Preferred: Experience in health, wellness, supplements, fitness, or consumer health.
Preferred: Experience managing multiple brands or agency/vendor relationships simultaneously.
Preferred: Experience sourcing, evaluating, and managing agencies or freelance creative talent.
Preferred: Experience producing creative performance reports or internal learning updates.
Preferred: Familiarity with ad libraries, customer-review research, Reddit, Amazon reviews, TikTok research, and competitor analysis.

Benefits

$8,000–$10,000 USD per month in compensation.
Performance bonus opportunity of up to $3,000 USD.
Fully remote working environment.
US-time-zone overlap preferred, enabling collaboration with distributed teams.
High-ownership position with direct influence over creative performance and customer acquisition.
Opportunity to lead creative production across multiple agency partners and an internal team.
Exposure to DTC, eCommerce, UGC, paid social, and direct-response creative at scale.
Opportunity to build repeatable systems for creative production, agency management, testing, and performance reporting.
Close collaboration with Creative Strategists, Editors, Designers, and Art Directors.
Opportunity to contribute directly to the growth of a high-performing consumer brand.

! Als junges, ambitioniertes Start-up kombinieren wir Leistung mit einer kreativen Unternehmenskultur, in der Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und Innovation großgeschrieben werden.

Du steuerst für Kunden in deinem Portfolio den gesamten kreativen Prozess – vom Writing über Design bis zum Layout – mithilfe modernster KI-Systeme. Diese Position bietet dir zudem die explizite Perspektive zur Weiterentwicklung als Team Lead.

WAS DU BEI UNS BEWEGST

KI-Orchestrator*in:
Du steuerst und optimierst den gesamten Creative-Prozess durch den gezielten Einsatz moderner KI-Workflows. Dabei kombinierst du verschiedene Tools und Technologien, entwickelst effiziente Prozesse und sorgst dafür, dass hochwertige Werbemittel schneller, skalierbarer und datengetrieben entstehen.

Full Funnel & CRO Expert*in:
Du denkst über einzelne Creatives hinaus und entwickelst Strategien für den gesamten Marketing-Funnel. Strateg*in:
Du entwickelst kreative Konzepte, die Performance und Markenverständnis miteinander verbinden. Auf Basis von Daten, Marktanalysen und Zielgruppen-Insights leitest du Strategien ab, testest neue Ansätze und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Creatives nachhaltig erfolgreich sind.

Creative AI Expert*in:
Du beobachtest aktuelle Entwicklungen im Bereich Generative AI, testest neue Tools und Methoden und integrierst diese sinnvoll in unsere Workflows. Dabei hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse kontinuierlich und treibst Innovation im Creative-Bereich aktiv voran.

Redakteur*in:
Mit deinem geschulten Blick für Storytelling, Copywriting und Conversion optimierst du Texte und Werbemittel. Du redigierst Assets deiner Kolleg*innen, gibst konstruktives Feedback und stellst sicher, dass unsere Creatives sowohl qualitativ als auch strategisch höchsten Ansprüchen gerecht werden.

Sparringspartner*in:
Du teilst dein Wissen aktiv mit dem Team, unterstützt Kolleg*innen bei kreativen und strategischen Fragestellungen und bringst neue Ideen, Impulse und Best Practices ein. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr den Creative-Bereich kontinuierlich weiter.

Kommunikator*in:
Du arbeitest eng mit Media Buying, Video Editing und weiteren Teams zusammen, stimmst Strategien ab und sorgst dafür, dass kreative Ideen effizient umgesetzt werden. Dabei kommunizierst du klar, lösungsorientiert und auf Augenhöhe.

Leader-Mindset:
Du übernimmst Verantwortung, treibst den unternehmensweiten AI Shift aktiv mit voran und entwickelst sowohl dich selbst als auch das Team kontinuierlich weiter. Perspektivisch übernimmst du eine Führungsrolle als Team Lead und gestaltest die strategische Ausrichtung des Creative-Teams maßgeblich mit.

WAS DU MITBRINGST

Native Advertising Expertise:
Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich Native Advertising mit und verstehst, welche Mechanismen erfolgreiche Performance-Creatives ausmachen. Ein reiner Copywriting-Hintergrund ist kein Muss – entscheidend ist dein Verständnis für Performance-Marketing. Grundlegendes oder weiterführendes Wissen im Bereich Media Buying ist ein Plus.

Proaktivität & Drive:
Du gehst Roadblocks proaktiv an, findest neue Blickwinkel und setzt deine Ideen eigenverantwortlich um. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung und treibst Themen mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch voran.

Tech-Affinität:
Du begeisterst dich für KI-Tools und deren Integration in kreative Workflows. Du testest neue Technologien, denkst innovativ und nutzt AI gezielt, um Prozesse und Ergebnisse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Kommunikation:
Du kommunizierst souverän auf Deutsch und Englisch (Unternehmenssprache) – sowohl im Team als auch gegenüber Kund*innen. Eine klare, lösungsorientierte Kommunikation ist für dich selbstverständlich.

Performance-first-Mindset:
Du denkst Kreativität immer mit Blick auf Performance. Ob KMU oder Enterprise-Kunde wie ERGO, 1KOMMA5° oder Kijimea – du verstehst die Anforderungen einer Performance-Marketing-Agentur und überzeugst durch eine proaktive Kommunikation, hohe Erreichbarkeit und Erfahrung im Umgang mit Kund*innen.

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

Teamgeist:
Werde Teil eines dynamischen, internationalen Teams, das mit viel Spaß und Leidenschaft außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse erzielt.

Weiterentwicklung:
Wir fördern deine persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung gezielt und individuell.

Offene Türen & flache Hierarchien:
Bei uns herrschen flache Hierarchien und eine offene Kommunikation – wir haben immer ein offenes Ohr.

Events:
Unsere Events sind ein Highlight! Neben dem jährlichen Work Retreat und der Weihnachtsfeier bieten wir regelmäßige Teamevents, die den Zusammenhalt stärken und für jede Menge Spaß sorgen.

Hybrid arbeiten:
Arbeite flexibel von zu Hause oder im Büro – unser Kölner Office ist schön, aber auch Remote-Arbeit ist möglich. Flexible Arbeitszeiten runden das Angebot ab.

Moderne Ausstattung:
Du erhältst von uns alles, was du für deine Arbeit brauchst – von Laptop über Tastatur bis hin zum Headset. Alles ist auf dem neuesten Stand.

Sport & Gesundheit:
Nutze deine kostenfreie Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club oder bei Wellhub und probiere deine Lieblingssportarten aus. Außerdem sorgen wir für frisches Obst, Snacks, kostenlosen Kaffee und (Soft-) Getränke im Büro sowie gemeinsame Lunch Breaks, bei denen wir dein Mittagessen übernehmen.

Deutschlandticket inklusive:
Wir übernehmen dein Deutschlandticket (Jobticket), damit du stressfrei und bequem zur Arbeit kommst!

ÜBER UNS

Xevio ist eine Performance-Agentur mit Schwerpunkt auf Media Buying, Content Creation und Native Advertising
. Wir arbeiten mit Unternehmen aus verschiedenen Branchen zusammen, um maßgeschneiderte Full-Funnel-Lösungen zu entwickeln. Unser zentral gelegenes Büro in Kölnist die perfekte Basis für kreatives Arbeiten und Austausch. Erfahre noch mehr über uns auf xevio.io.

Creative Director - Global B2B Travel

London | Hybrid

VMA Group & Jack Pascoe is partnering with a leading global organisation within the travel sector
to appoint an exceptional Creative Director
into its Global Marketing function.
This is a significant creative leadership opportunity for someone who combines big-picture creative vision with outstanding visual craft, commercial thinking and inspirational leadership
.

Operating across two established international B2B brands, the Creative Director will set the creative direction and quality standard across global campaigns, brand storytelling, digital, social, video, web, events and corporate communications.

This isn't a role for someone who simply manages creative output from a distance.
We are looking for a creative leader with genuine ideas, presence and conviction.
someone capable of setting the vision, challenging a brief, developing concepts, inspiring designers and confidently presenting creative thinking to senior marketing stakeholders, a leader who does so from the front, is capable to be hands-on and strategic, motivates and educates team members.

The Role

You will act as the senior creative voice across the organisation's global corporate marketing function, helping shape how its brands show up across markets, channels and customer touchpoints.
You will:
Set and champion the creative vision and quality standards
across two international B2B brands.
Turn brand and marketing strategy into distinctive, compelling and commercially effective creative ideas.
Lead the development of integrated campaigns across brand, paid media, digital, social, video, web, events and corporate communications
.
Shape and elevate creative briefs alongside senior brand and marketing leaders.
Lead brand storytelling and develop creative ideas that build stronger emotional connections with business audiences.
Ensure creative works across the entire B2B customer journey
, from awareness and demand generation through to conversion and retention.
Present creative concepts and strategic rationale confidently to senior stakeholders.
Protect and evolve established brand identities while continually raising creative standards.
Champion innovation across formats, platforms and ways of working.
Explore how AI and generative creative technologies
can improve ideation, production, localisation and creative efficiency.
Remain close enough to the work to personally contribute to concepts, art direction and creative thinking when required.

Leadership

A major part of this position is people leadership.
You will lead a globally distributed creative design team of nine
, including two Design Managers, with team members operating across international markets.

You will be responsible for creating a high-performance creative culture where talented people have the direction, environment and support to produce their best work.
That will include:
Setting clear creative direction across different regions and time zones.
Coaching and developing creative talent.
Building consistency and cohesion across a distributed team.
Raising standards around craft, accountability and creative ambition.
Working closely with internal marketing, content, growth and demand generation teams.
Partnering with external agencies, freelancers and specialist creative partners where required.
Helping shape future decisions around team development, creative technology and operating models.

Commercial Creative Leadership

The organisation is looking for someone who understands that great creative isn't simply about producing beautiful work.
You should understand how creative contributes to brand growth, demand generation, pipeline, conversion and customer engagement
.
You will help establish meaningful measures of creative effectiveness and work with marketing and project management teams to demonstrate the commercial contribution of the creative function.

About You

We are interested in speaking with established Creative Directors who can demonstrate a combination of creative excellence, strategic thinking, leadership and commercial understanding
.

Ideally, you will bring:

Around 10+ years' experience across creative, design and brand
, including significant experience operating at Creative Director level.
A strong design and art-direction background
with exceptional visual judgement.
An outstanding portfolio covering integrated campaigns, brand, digital advertising, video and multi-channel creative.
Proven experience leading and developing creative teams.
Experience operating within a B2B environment
and an understanding of the B2B marketing funnel.
The ability to connect creative ideas and execution with measurable commercial objectives.
Experience working across complex global or matrix organisations.
Confidence presenting creative thinking to senior marketing leaders and C-suite stakeholders.
The ability to move comfortably between strategic creative leadership and detailed conversations with designers.
A strong understanding of how creative needs to adapt across different channels and platforms.
An informed and progressive view of AI-assisted creative workflows
.
The communication skills and presence required to influence stakeholders across functions, regions and levels of seniority.

Experience within travel, technology, professional services or another sophisticated B2B environment
would be particularly relevant, although sector experience is less important than the quality of your creative leadership and portfolio.

What Makes This Opportunity Different?
This is an opportunity to become the senior creative voice within a major international travel organisation
, influencing two established global brands and leading a talented international team.
The business already has strong brand foundations in place.
The opportunity is to take those foundations further, raising creative ambition, evolving how the brands communicate, embedding smarter ways of working and creating work that is both creatively outstanding and commercially meaningful
.

You will sit at the intersection of creative, brand, marketing and technology
, with the opportunity to materially influence how a global organisation approaches creative work.
Interested?
If you are an experienced Creative Director with a strong visual and conceptual background and are interested in leading creative across a global B2B organisation, I'd be keen to hear from you.

Please apply directly or contact Jack Pascoe at VMA GROUP
for a confidential conversation.

Due to a high volume of applicants, we are unable to respond to everyone. We will get in touch if you are successful in your application.

VMA GROUP is a leading international interim, contract, temporary and permanent recruitment and executive search specialist. We are specifically focused on providing support to the communications, marketing, digital and change communities.
Our specialist practice areas cover: communications, corporate communications, internal communications, change communications, PR, media relations, financial communications, CSR, public affairs, investor relations, marketing, brand, digital marketing and agency services.
We have a reputation for providing expert consultancy services and advice, supported by in-depth knowledge of the professions we recruit for. Our thought leadership and benchmarking studies have become go-to resources for the communications, marketing, digital and change industries, supporting planning and decision-making for organisations of all shapes and sizes.
In the UK, VMA GROUP has offices in London, Bristol and Manchester but we work with organisations and individuals on a global basis.
VMA GROUP is committed to equal opportunities and is an Inclusive+ Recruiter.

jobs.title: Staff Creative Design Lead
jobs.description:
Mr Who?

MrQ - we're an awesome, award winning online casino launched in 2018. We're big on tech, big on performance and most of all - big on fun. Over the years, we have experienced explosive growth - which means we need more rock stars to join our quest for total world domination.

The Head of Creative can't be in every room, in every brief, and on every deadline at once. And a creative team only scales if craft is backed by discipline, otherwise quality lives in one person's head and falls over the moment they're busy.

This role fixes both. You're the senior craft authority who owns the design language day to day, the deputy who can steer when the Head of Creative steps out, and the person who instils the practices that keep the whole team's output consistent, on-brand and fast. You raise the ceiling by making the best work, and raise the floor by making great work repeatable.

What You Will Do

The craft (setting the standard by making the best work).

Concept and execute design across the brand; campaigns, brand assets, social, CRM, sponsorship activations, merch, the lot, at a level that defines what "good" means for the team.
Help own and steer the MrQ design language: the type, layout, colour, illustration and codes that make us recognisable with the logo removed. Evolve it deliberately; protect it fiercely.
Take the hardest, highest-stakes briefs yourself and set the benchmark others work to.
Stay genuinely hands-on. This is a maker's role, not a role that only reviews other people's making.

The discipline (holding the standard by building how the team works).

Establish and run the working practices that keep a fast team sharp: briefing standards, feedback loops, file and naming hygiene, version control, hand-off and archiving that survive real deadlines.
Own and maintain the design system; components, templates and guidelines the team actually uses because they're good, not because they're mandated.
Set the quality bar and hold it. Give feedback that's direct, useful and makes the work better, without crushing the person who made it.
Build the organisational discipline that lets craft scale, so quality lives in the system, not just in one person's instincts.

The deputy (leading when the Creative Director can't).

Represent the creative point of view in meetings, reviews and cross-team discussions when the Creative Director isn't there. Hold the line on quality and brand.
Spearhead key design initiatives end to end; brief, concept, delivery, and the people around it.
Mentor and steer the wider design team, leading from expertise rather than authority.
Be a trusted second pair of eyes and a sounding board; the person the Creative Director can hand something to and stop worrying about it.

What We're Looking For

You've spent years designing at a high level and your portfolio proves it. Not just polished, but considered. Strong ideas executed with real craft. You can point at work and explain every decision behind it.

You're digital to your core. You understand platform-native design, how work behaves across every touchpoint from paid social to product, and the difference between design that looks good in a deck and design that performs in the wild.

You're a systems thinker as much as a maker. You've built or run a design system, or set up the working practices of a team, and you've seen first-hand how much faster good discipline makes everyone. You know that "process" is only a dirty word when it's done badly.

You can lead without the title doing the work for you. People follow your judgement because you're usually right and you show your reasoning. You're comfortable being handed responsibility and comfortable handing it back up when something needs escalating.

You've got backbone and humility in equal measure. You'll challenge work that isn't good enough, and take it gracefully when someone challenges yours.

You care about casino, gaming or entertainment, or you're genuinely curious about it. You get why people play, and why doing it properly matters.

8+ years in hands-on design roles, with a portfolio that shows real craft… and teeth. Considered, not just polished. Work you can defend decision by decision, in a room full of people who know the difference.

Evidence you've built how a team works, not just what it makes. Briefing standards, feedback loops, file and version hygiene and hand-off. Working practices you personally set up, that survived real deadlines and were still in use a year later.
You've built or run a design system a team actually used. Components, templates and guidelines that stayed alive because they were good, not because they were mandated.
Proven mentorship. Designers who are visibly better because you were in the room, and feedback that's direct, useful and makes the work stronger without crushing the person who made it.
Leadership that doesn't need the title to do the work. You've deputised for a creative lead: held the line on quality and brand in rooms they weren't in, and known which calls were yours and which to hand back up.
Genuine curiosity about casino, gaming or entertainment. You don't need to be a player; you need to understand why people play.

Reporting to: Darren Suffolk

Level: 5

What We Offer

At MrQ, we take pride in providing an array of fantastic benefits to our valued team members. Enjoy a competitive salary package that recognizes your hard work and dedication. Need some extra time off? We've got you covered with additional leave days, and we believe in celebrating life's special moments, including your birthday, with dedicated birthday leave. Family matters to us, too, which is why we offer a generous four-week parental leave. Your well-being is our priority, supported by international health and life insurance. Stay motivated with wellness incentives and seize opportunities for personal and professional growth with our growth allowance. Embrace a flexible working environment that caters to your needs, and join our friendly and multinational team, where collaboration and camaraderie flourish. At MrQ, we're committed to ensuring that your experience with us goes beyond just a job – it's a fulfilling journey with a supportive community.

We are committed to fostering a workplace that values and celebrates diversity. We welcome individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we believe that a diverse and inclusive environment leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equal opportunities for all employees and strive to create a space where everyone's voices are heard and respected. Join us in our journey to build a truly inclusive workplace where every person can thrive and contribute to our collective success.

To help our recruitment team work efficiently, please apply to the role that best matches your skills and experience. Our team will consider you for other similar roles as well!

MrQ - we're an awesome, award winning online casino launched in 2018. We're big on tech, big on performance and most of all - big on fun. Over the years, we have experienced explosive growth - which means we need more rock stars to join our quest for total world domination.

jobs.title: Applied AI Lead
jobs.description:
About Owner 


    Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants. 


    We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business. 


    It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.


  


  Product philosophy 


    Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically. 


    Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it. 


    Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.


  


  Our vision


  


  We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.


  


  But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.


  


  Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.


  


  In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.


  


  Our traction


  


  Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.


  


  More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.


  


  Our team


  


  Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.


  


  We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.


  


  Where we work


  


  Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!


  


  Why we are looking for you


  We are scaling Owner's Applied AI organization. This is a fast-paced team that works on the most valuable opportunities we can find anywhere in the business. As an Applied AI Lead, you'll be responsible for finding those opportunities in the first place: looking across everything happening at Owner, understanding where AI can have the most impact, and sizing the potential before a single line of code gets written. Then you'll build, ship, and iterate on the solution until the impact shows up.


  Some of these opportunities create efficiency by cutting out manual work that no longer needs to be manual. Others create better outcomes entirely: processes that now perform far beyond what they used to, and things we always wanted to do that only became practical with AI. You'll chase both, and you'll be the one deciding which come first.


  This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.


  


  You should definitely apply if you…


  
   
    Care more about picking the right problem than about using the fanciest tool for it


   
    Love the hunt: scanning a business, finding what's broken or underpowered, and putting a number on the prize


   
    Get more energy from building and shipping than from analyzing and presenting


   
    Dive deep to understand root causes when solving problems, and become a subject matter expert along the way


   
    Aren't afraid to pick up new tools and skills, from Claude Code to custom ML pipelines, whatever the problem requires


   
    Want to see your work change the numbers, and feel unsatisfied until it does


   
    Thrive in ambiguity and don't need a playbook to figure out what to work on next


  
  What we've built so far


  
   
    LLM-powered binary classifier for restaurant concept fit with Owner's product. Ran on over 300k establishments in the US.


   
    Hyperpersonalized outbound email engine, sending around 5k unique emails daily with a best-in-class reply rate.


   
    Automated pre-call research tool, eliminating the manual work that sales reps previously had to complete before every dial. Increased dial volume by almost double.


   
    Gradient Boosted Tree for predicting call pickup rate. Trained on dozens of features across tens of thousands of pieces of data, resulting in up to a ~2.3x increased pickup rate for top-identified leads. (ML experience is NOT required for this role; we used Claude Code to teach ourselves enough ML to build this.)


   
    Intelligent routing (iRouting) system incorporating our new pickup rate prediction score to optimize lead distribution on a daily basis.


  
  The impact you will have


  
   
    You'll own the map of AI opportunity across the business: identifying problems and opportunities, dissecting and sizing them, and deciding what gets built next.


   
    The projects we work on are significant enough to alter the trajectory of the business. Recent builds have driven double digit improvements to company-wide KPIs, and the backlog holds many more with similar potential.


   
    You'll carry each build from diagnosis through shipping, deployment, adoption, and iteration. A project is finished when the impact we set out for is visible, and you'll own that full arc.


   
    Many of the problems in our backlog are ambitious enough that they could be standalone products. We'll provide the tools and resources you need to execute them end to end.


  
  Who you'll work with


  
   
    Reporting Structure: This role reports to Jonathan Shenkman.


   
    Team Collaboration: You'll work day to day with our Applied AI team and partner

jobs.title: AI Creative Lead (Remote)
jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Forbes Advisor is hiring an AI Creative Lead to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct-response marketing, and a hands-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character-locked stills through AI video, lip-sync, and voiceover to editor-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed.

The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real-ad output from output that just reads as AI.

We are a human-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short-term decision.

Responsibilities



Own generation end-to-end for paid social and native creative: character-locked stills, AI video, lip-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor-ready footage. Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot. Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native-audio vs. img-to-video) and keep a live view of a fast-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time. Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available. Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass. Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one. Own the generative-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards. Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes. Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on-voice, on-persona, and matched beat-for-beat to the script (AV sync). Bring a direct-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good. Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline. Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales. Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self-serve the routine work. 

Requirements

4+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables. A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished. Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed. Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi-subject-consistency image models, AI video (native-audio and img-to-video), lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade-offs, not just tool names. Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame. Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re-rolling until something lands. Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue. A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft. Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high-output content environment. jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Creative Strategist

Overview

The Advisors Client Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, this team provides consulting, marketing, loyalty and analytics to financial institutions and merchants globally.

Specialized Product Delivery (SPD) is a department within Advisors Client Services organization and focuses on the building out of new in-house capabilities to service our clients.

The Creative Strategy role within SPD is focused on supporting the strategy development process that fuels innovative client solutions. You’ll work closely with Senior strategists, Creatives, Data analysts to help craft compelling narratives and uncover insights that drive business impact. This is an ideal role for a curious, analytical, and collaborative thinker who wants to grow at the intersection of business strategy and creative execution.

With deep experience from leading or consolidated creative agencies, the Creative Strategist brings strong strategic judgment, cultural understanding, and creative sensitivity.

In this role candidate to provide strategic guidance and quality control, while remaining hands-on in research, briefing, and creative strategy development.

The position requires strategic rigor, strong writing skills, and the diplomacy to work effectively with creatives, clients, and account teams.

Role

Strategic Development & Ownership
Lead the development of creative strategies on key briefs, in close collaboration with Creative Strategy Manager
Translate business objectives, brand challenges, and insights into clear strategic directions and creative platforms
Own strategic thinking across assigned projects, ensuring consistency, clarity, and creative ambition

Insight & Research Excellence

Conduct and guide desk research across markets, competitors, consumers, and cultural trends
Distill complex information into sharp, inspiring insights that unlock strong creative ideas
Push beyond surface-level findings to uncover meaningful and differentiated strategic perspectives
Creative Briefing & Writing
Write high-quality creative briefs that inspire creative teams while aligning internal and client stakeholders
Shape strategic narratives, key messages, and presentation materials for client-facing deliverables
Participate in briefing sessions and creative handovers
Work closely with creatives, account managers, project managers, and clients to ensure smooth strategic delivery
Act as a strategic partner to creative teams throughout the development process, providing constructive feedback and guidance
Navigate differing viewpoints with confidence and diplomacy, balancing creative ambition with client and business realities
Contribute to the development of strategic best practices, frameworks, and internal tools

All About You

6–10 years of experience in creative strategy, brand planning, or communications strategy within leading or consolidated creative agencies
Experience working on top-tier brands and complex, multi-channel campaigns
Strong background in full-funnel and brand-led creative strategy
Excellent strategic writing skills, particularly in insight articulation and creative briefs
Confident presenter and storyteller, comfortable in senior internal and client-facing settings
Highly collaborative, with strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills
Fluent English is essential, with the ability to confidently write, present, and lead strategic conversations in an international environment
Curious about culture, creativity, and how brands show up meaningfully in people’s lives

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Video & UGC Creator (m/w/d) - Meta Ads & KI-Video
jobs.description:
Werkstudent Video \& UGC Creator (m/w/d) \| 100 % Remote \| 13,90 EUR/Std. \| 15\-20 Std./Woche \| ab sofort

Wir sind eine junge E\-Commerce\-Gruppe im Sports\-Memorabilia\-Bereich mit zwei Shopify\-Shops: TheCardClub.de (originale Autogrammkarten von Fußball\- und Basketballstars sowie Trading Card Mystery Packs) und Authentiks (100 % authentifizierte, signierte Fußball\-Trikots im Premium\-Segment). Beide Shops verkaufen fast ausschließlich über Meta Ads. Was am Ende entscheidet, ist das Video.

Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der vor der Kamera steht und das Video anschließend selbst fertig macht. Du bist das Gesicht unserer Ads \- kein Model, sondern jemand, der ein Trikot auspackt, ein Mystery Pack öffnet und in zwei Sätzen erklärt, warum man das haben will.

DEINE AUFGABE

* Vor der Kamera: UGC\-Videos, in denen du selbst sprichst \- Unboxings, Produktvorstellungen, Talking Heads, Reaktionen. Das ist der Kern der Stelle, nicht ein Zusatz
* KI\-Videos produzieren: Higgsfield, HeyGen und Co. für alles, was wir nicht selbst drehen können \- Szenen, Avatare, Voiceover, Animationen
* Selbst schneiden: Schnitt, Untertitel, Text\-Overlays, Hook in den ersten zwei Sekunden, Musik, Export in 9:16, 4:5 und 1:1
* Werbewinkel mitdenken: Welcher Hook, welcher Pain Point, welches Versprechen \- du lieferst nicht nur Material, du entwickelst Ideen
* Was funktioniert, weiterentwickeln: Die Performance\-Zahlen aus dem Meta Ads Manager bekommst du von uns, du baust darauf die nächste Runde
* Organischer Content für Instagram und TikTok, wenn ein Video sich dafür eignet

WAS DU MITBRINGST

* Immatrikuliert an einer Hochschule (Pflicht für den Werkstudentenstatus) \- Studienrichtung ist uns egal
* Du gehst gern vor die Kamera und wirkst dabei natürlich. Wir wollen zwei, drei Beispiele sehen \- eigener TikTok\- oder Instagram\-Account, ein UGC\-Reel, irgendetwas Echtes mit dir darin
* Schnitt beherrschst du selbstständig: CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci oder womit du sonst arbeitest
* KI ist für dich Werkzeug, nicht Zauberei: Higgsfield, HeyGen, ChatGPT, Claude \- und was du sonst nutzt (Runway, ElevenLabs, Midjourney)
* Grundverständnis von Marketing und Werbung: Du weißt ungefähr, wie Meta Ads funktionieren, warum ein Creative verkauft und was eine Marke von einem beliebigen Shop unterscheidet. Wir erwarten keine Agenturerfahrung \- wir erwarten, dass du verstehst, worum es geht, und Lust hast, tiefer einzusteigen
* Zuverlässigkeit und Tempo: lieber Dienstag drei fertige Videos als in drei Wochen der eine perfekte Film
* Bonus: Interesse an Fußball, Basketball oder Trading Cards

WAS WIR BIETEN

* 13,90 EUR/Std., 15\-20 Std./Woche, freie Zeiteinteilung \- in der Klausurenphase runterfahren ist normal und kein Problem
* 100 % remote, deutschlandweit. Produkte zum Filmen (Trikots, Karten, Mystery Packs) schicken wir dir zu
* Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründer, kurze Wege, keine Abstimmungsschleifen
* Deine Videos laufen mit echtem Werbebudget \- du siehst innerhalb weniger Tage an echten Zahlen, was funktioniert hat. Das lernst du in keinem Praktikum so schnell
* Zugang zu unseren KI\-Tools (u. a. Higgsfield), Briefings, Rohmaterial und Marken\-Guidelines kommen von uns
* Echte Einblicke in Meta Ads, Shopify und den Aufbau zweier Marken \- du darfst mitdenken, nicht nur abliefern
* Langfristige Perspektive: Wenn es passt, wächst die Rolle mit

BEWERBUNG

Formlos, aber bitte mit drei Dingen: 1\. Ein bis drei Videos, in denen du selbst zu sehen bist \- Link reicht, gern auch dein eigener Account. Es muss nichts Professionelles sein, wir wollen sehen, wie du vor der Kamera wirkst. 2\. Womit du schneidest und welche KI\-Tools du nutzt. 3\. Ab wann und wie viele Stunden du kannst. Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

Gehalt: 13,90€ pro Stunde

Erwartete Arbeitsstunden: 15\.0–20\.0 pro Woche

Leistungen:

* Flexible Arbeitszeiten

Arbeitsort: Homeoffice

jobs.description:
🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!

Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.

As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.

We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

💻 Role

We're looking for a Performance Creative Lead to join the EU marketing team at Whatnot and build the creative engine that fuels our paid growth across Europe.

You'll own the full paid creative system: the strategy, team, operations, and output that help us produce high-performing ads at scale. You'll work across creator-led ads, in-house production, edited community content, agencies, and creator marketplace platforms. You won't be tied to one way of making creatives - your job is to find the fastest, highest-quality path to assets that perform, including when that means sourcing and managing external partners to scale beyond what the in-house team can produce alone.

We already produce a high volume of creatives today. The next phase is about scaling that output with more intentionality: better systems, sharper creative strategy, stronger testing loops, better localization, and clear answers on which creative investments are driving more first-time buyers at lower cost.

You'll build and manage a team that brings together creative production talent and creator management expertise. You'll be a player-coach: raise the bar, hire strong talent, and still get in the work yourself. At Whatnot, everyone is an IC.

You Will

Own the EU performance creative engine across paid social: you're accountable for the volume and quality of creative Europe ships every month.
Balance performance and brand: push for creative that drives results without letting it drift from what makes Whatnot recognizable and trustworthy.
Build the strategy and operating system to scale creative output while reducing guesswork, improving quality, and increasing creative impact.
Manage and develop a growing team as a player-coach, setting direction and holding a high bar while staying hands-on in the work.
Partner closely with Performance Marketing to build the creative testing roadmap, understand what's working, diagnose performance issues, and turn learnings into better creative.
Lead creative output across multiple pipelines: creator-led ads, in-house production, edited community content, agencies, and creator marketplace platforms, deciding which external partners and platforms are worth investing in and managing those relationships directly.
Build systems that keep working as we scale: briefing, production workflows, asset tracking, localization, creator workflows, and feedback loops.
Partner with the US Performance Creative team so top-performing creative travels between markets, and so Europe adopts and helps improve the tools and playbooks built for global marketing.
Ensure you and your team use data to decide what to repeat, cut, or test next, moving from one-off creative wins to repeatable creative systems.
Stay hands-on when needed: sourcing creators, shaping briefs, reviewing edits, producing assets, jumping into workflows, and unblocking the team.
Drive AI adoption across the team to move faster and build better processes: speeding up research, organizing creative learnings, improving workflows, creating brief variants, summarizing performance insights, localizing inputs, and reducing manual work.

We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in-person time for planning, problem-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of either our London hub or our Berlin hub.

👋 You

People who do well at Whatnot tend to be comfortable figuring things out as they go, biased toward action, and genuinely curious about what they're building. They care more about outcomes than credit and stay close to the product and the people using it.

You're a performance creative leader who has scaled creative output without losing sight of quality, brand, and business impact, and who stays hands-on, jumping into briefs, edits, creator concepts, or whatever else needs momentum.

Experience building or managing a high-volume performance creative program across multiple workstreams, channels, and markets.
People management experience, including hiring, developing talent, setting direction, and raising the bar for creative output across different functions (e.g. production and creator management).
Experience sourcing, vetting, and managing external partners (e.g. agencies, freelancers, or creator marketplace platforms) as a lever to scale output beyond what an in-house team can produce alone.
Strong paid performance fluency. You can read creative performance data, brainstorm with paid marketers, challenge assumptions, and turn learnings into sharper creative tests.
Strong operating ability. You can build systems for briefing, production, asset tracking, localization, creator workflows, and feedback loops without slowing the team down.
Strong creative taste across short-form video, creator-led ads, UGC, edited assets, and native paid social formats, with the judgment to protect the brand while still making creative that feels native and built to perform.
AI-forward leadership. You drive AI adoption across a team to reduce manual work, improve workflows, speed up research, summarize learnings, localize inputs, and help the team move faster.
A sharp, specific eye for what good looks like: in a brief, a creator concept, a cut, a caption, a final asset.
Comfort working across Europe, where creative needs to be localized by market, language, and customer behavior.

Bonus If You Have

Experience in a fast-growing startup, DTC brand, or marketplace business.
Experience creating assets across multiple communities, product types, or categories.
Interest or experience in collectibles or fashion culture. You understand the tone, trends, and what resonates with these communities.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
DEPT® is the Growth Invention Company, sitting at the intersection of marketing and technology. The Senior Creative Strategist role is part of our Creative & Media team based in Amsterdam. Our building is filled with a vibrant mix of talents, ranging from Creatives, Influencer Marketers, and a range of Strategists, to Account Managers, AI Experts, and Marketing Automation Consultants. Together, we blend imaginative storytelling, forward-facing creativity, and cutting-edge technology to create impactful creative work that drives growth for our clients like Netflix, Canva, Stokke, Foot Locker, Philips & Praxis.

Job Purpose

The Creative Strategist at DEPT® are at the heart of the action, operating at the intersection of creativity, culture, humanity, business, and technology - helping create work that moves people and drives growth. We don’t have a proprietary framework or process. We don’t like to follow best practices because they’re based on the past. In a world of constant flux and endless opportunity, we believe strategy is crucial to imagine the path forward.

At this level, you are putting your foundational skills into practice and earning authority with clients and creative teams. While our seniors and directors define the vision, you are the indispensable thinker bringing it to life - owning projects, learning through doing, and finding the insights that spark great work.

Key Responsibilities

Own the project:
Step up to own more projects and see them through from start to finish, utilizing the guidance and air cover of a Senior/Director when you need it.

Interrogate the challenge:
Be a fearless, honest, and suspicious interrogator of the brand, the challenge, and the world it lives in.

Craft the springboard:
Consistently develop strategies, briefs, and thought-starters that excite, inspire and give clear direction.

Think beyond boundaries:
Connect differently shaped projects and strategies in ways that they all lead to effective outcomes.

That’s the core of it. Beyond that, we expect you to care about the work, the craft and humans, be comfortable in front of crowds and workshops, and be utterly yourself at all times.

What We Are Looking For

That’s one list. Sorry, here’s another. It’s about some traits we like:

Relentless curiosity: You love playing the investigative journalist. You get under the skin of the problem, the audience, immerse yourself in the business and throw yourself into culture - all for the betterment of the work (and because there’s no better place than a reddit rabbithole).
Intelligent imagination: You don't just observe; you make leaps of thinking that reveal entirely new ways of looking at a problem or an opportunity.
Effective storytelling: You are skilled in the art of writing, crafting arguments and telling stories in ways that help create clarity, excitement and buy-in for ideas.
Creative development: A strategy isn’t great until it leads to great work. You thrive in inspiring, supporting, protecting, and nurturing creativity from start to finish.
Distilling complexity: The world is increasingly complex and fragmented. You’re able to process, distill, and demystify that chaos into simple and compelling insights.
Finger on the pulse: You know what’s going on in culture, in tech, on social and some other weird corners of the internet, and are able to turn that knowledge into action (or just great water cooler conversation).
Team Player: There’s a perception that the best strategists are mysterious wizards who pontificate from ivory towers - not at DEPT®. Here getting to the best possible work is a team sport. Everyone does their part for the greater good.

Language requirements: We’re looking for someone who can work in Dutch and English. Any other languages are a bonus.

That’s it. Enough lists. If any of this seems right up your alley, we’d love to hear from you.

What Now

Apart from the CV we would like to see:

A short cover letter that tells us a little about you, your background, and what you want to achieve.
It doesn’t need to be super formal. Relax. No one scary will read it. Please write it in your voice.

If you have a portfolio/website, please include it
. It’s helpful to know what your role in the work was. And if you’re not currently a strategist, feel free to include some relevant samples of interesting work from other fields.

WE OFFER

A flexible, hybrid working policy (2-3 days from the office, depending on location) and the opportunity to work from abroad for 13 weeks a year.
24 vacation days per year and the possibility to buy an unlimited number of extra vacation days.
DEPT®/YOU Learning Menu and DEPT®/YOU Special Programs. Develop your skills with courses and programs tailored to your needs.
Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform, gym and wellness discounts, and healthy lunches at the office.
Get a discount on your lease bike and ride in style. You can also enjoy hassle free-commutes with an NS Business Card.
A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021, has been named a Great Place To Work since 2022 in the Netherlands and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.
Awesome clients. Whether big, small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with all of them. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
You can discover even more employee benefits here.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

Deine Aufgaben

Mission

Content für unsere Kunden entsteht bei yoursquares nicht mehr Stück für Stück, sondern über ein System, das du aufbaust. Sobald ein Creative bei einem Kunden zieht, lässt du daraus AI-gestützt binnen kurzer Zeit ein ganzes Set an Varianten entstehen – andere Hooks, neue Formate, kürzere und längere Schnitte – und bringst sie parallel in den jeweiligen Account. Jede Version bleibt klar auf die Marke des Kunden zugeschnitten, und was weiterläuft, entscheiden die Zahlen, nicht das Bauchgefühl.

Produktentwicklung & Workflows

Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Produkt-Team unseren AI-Creative-Stack weiter und gestaltest Systeme, mit denen wir deutlich mehr hochwertige Werbemittel in kürzerer Zeit produzieren können.
Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Content, AI, Performance Marketing und Produkt und übersetzt operative Anforderungen in skalierbare Prozesse und Produktideen
Du musst dabei nicht jeden technischen Prozess selbst programmieren oder bauen. Entscheidend ist, dass du verstehst, was mit AI, Automatisierungen und modernen Tools möglich ist, wo technische Grenzen liegen und wie ein sinnvoller Workflow aussehen sollte
Wenn du Workflows, Automatisierungen oder Prototypen selbst bauen kannst: umso besser. Bei komplexeren Lösungen arbeitest du eng mit unserem Produkt- und Tech-Team zusammen und bringst die fachlichen Anforderungen ein

Automatisierte Content-Produktion

Du arbeitest täglich mit Tools wie Claude Code & Design, Make, Higgsfield. HeyGen, Midjourney, Runway, Nano Banana, und weiteren AI-Tools und verbindest sie sinnvoll miteinander
Du entwickelst Systeme, die aus Projektinformationen automatisiert unterschiedliche Paid-Social-Content, Videos, Landingpages und Creative-Varianten generieren können

Du liest unsere Performance-Dashboards selbst, erkennst Muster und übersetzt die Daten direkt in neue Creative-Hypothesen und Iterationen
Du analysierst unter anderem Hook Rate, CTR, Conversion Rate, CPL, CPA und ROAS und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse, um unsere Creative-Produktion kontinuierlich besser zu machen

Tooling, UX & Marktbeobachtung

Du gestaltest auch die UX/UI unserer internen AI-Tools und Workflows mit. Dein Anspruch: Komplexe Technologie muss so einfach werden, dass jede Person im Team sie intuitiv nutzen kann
Du beobachtest den AI-Markt kontinuierlich und erkennst früh, welche neuen Modelle, Tools und Workflows einen echten Vorteil bringen
Du testest neue Technologien schnell und pragmatisch. Wenn ein neues Tool unseren bestehenden Prozess deutlich verbessert, integrierst du es – statt an bestehenden Lösungen festzuhalten

Das Bringst Du Idealerweise Mit

Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Content, Creative, AI, Automation oder einem vergleichbaren digitalen Umfeld mit.
Du bist AI-Native. Claude, Prompting, Make und generative AI gehören für dich zum täglichen Werkzeugkasten und sind keine Buzzwords.
Tools wie Nano Banana, Runway, Midjourney oder vergleichbare Lösungen hast du dir idealerweise selbst beigebracht – und du beschäftigst dich bereits mit den Tools, die sie morgen ersetzen könnten.
Du verstehst nicht nur einzelne AI-Tools, sondern kannst erkennen, wie unterschiedliche Tools zu einem sinnvollen Workflow zusammenspielen.
Du hast Spaß daran, Prozesse zu automatisieren und stellst dir regelmäßig die Frage: Warum machen wir das eigentlich noch manuell?

Geschwindigkeit ist für dich kein Widerspruch zu Qualität. Die Vorstellung, sehr große Mengen an Creative-Varianten zu produzieren und zu testen, motiviert dich eher, als dass sie dich abschreckt.
Gleichzeitig hast du einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch: AI-Output darf nicht billig oder beliebig nach AI aussehen.
Du arbeitest eigenständig, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert und hast Lust darauf, Dinge aufzubauen, für die es noch keine fertige Anleitung gibt.

Starkes Verständnis für kreative Prozesse und die Fähigkeit, Timelines auch in dynamischen Episoden risikofrei durchzusetzen

Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau, Englisch ab B2
Scrum-/Kanban-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss

Full Mobile Office Work & Flexibilität: Arbeite deutschlandweit mit maximalem Vertrauen

Corporate Benefits, Fitnesszuschuss, mentale Gesundheits-Plattform (Nilo Health)
Mobilitäts-Zuschuss, Tierpatenschaft, Teamevents, Produktpakete

Bist Du überzeugt?

Wir sind auf der Suche nach Menschen, nicht Computern - wenn etwas nicht ganz auf dich zutrifft, deine Skills und Werte sonst aber zu uns passen, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung:-)

Schau' wenige Tage nach dem Versenden deiner Bewerbung sicherheitshalber bitte auch in deinem Spam-Ordner nach einer Mail von uns nach.

Wir sind MetaFlow - bei uns triffst du auf ein Team, das Verantwortung übernimmt, offen für neue Ideen ist und sich nicht an Altem festhält, nur weil es "schon immer so gemacht wurde".
