jobs.title: Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
(m/f/d)

About Stratio

Stratio keeps public transport running. We monitor fleet health in real time and tell the world's largest operators exactly what's going to fail before it does.

We're a small, technical team of about 50 people. There's no marketing department. You'd be building it.

The role

Our go-to-market runs on industry events. You own them end to end, and the content, the website and the automation around them.

This is a hands-on, one-person marketing function. No team to manage. You’ll brief a stand builder, a film crew, a designer or a PR freelancer when the work calls for them, and do everything else yourself. You do the work. You own the output. You use every tool available - especially LLMs and automation - to do the work of an entire department.

You’ll report directly to leadership and work closely with sales and product.

If you've ever been the only marketing person at a company and thrived, this is for you.

What your weeks look like

Events and speaking

Events are a major focus of this role. You run the event calendar: the shows where we exhibit, the conferences where we speak, and our own customer roundtables, on-site events at client sites and client advisory board.

For each stand: the booking, the design, the build contract, logistics, staffing, the run of show and the debrief.

For each talk: the abstract, the co-speaker, the deadline, the deck, the rehearsal.

After every event you report meetings held against meetings booked, deals generated and deals impacted, and you follow up with the leads generated in cooperation with our sales team to ensure event leads become opportunities in our pipeline.

Content creation

You write and publish case studies, blog posts, landing pages, LinkedIn posts, one-pagers, and sales enablement materials.

You produce our benchmark report with engineering, the abstracts and decks for our speakers, and the trade-press pushes around them.

You take raw inputs - a customer success metric, a product update, a conversation with a customer - and turn them into compelling stories.

You use LLMs daily to draft, iterate, and repurpose content across formats and channels.

You move fast without sacrificing quality.

Website ownership

You manage and update the website. New pages, copy changes, landing pages for campaigns, event pages and meeting-booking pages. You’re comfortable in a CMS. You don’t file a ticket to change a headline, you just do it.

You optimize for both traditional SEO and LLM discoverability, making sure that when someone asks “what’s the best predictive maintenance product,” Stratio shows up in the answer.

Campaigns and demand generation

You plan and execute campaigns to build our pipeline. They’re designed around the event calendar: the outreach that fills the meeting schedule before each show and the follow-up after it, webinars between events, LinkedIn content, paid only to named accounts, co-marketing with partners.

You draw up the account list for each event with sales, run the outreach and fill the calendar.

You set up tracking, measure what works, and kill what doesn’t. You think in terms of pipeline contribution.

Sales enablement

You build the materials that help the sales team close. Pitch decks, case studies, proposal templates.

You sit close to sales conversations and notice when the same objection keeps coming up, then you build something to handle it.

Analytics and reporting

You set up and maintain marketing analytics.

Per event: meetings held against booked, deals generated, deals impacted, what the field taught us and what we change because of it.

Website traffic, content performance, email metrics.

In the end how much pipeline we’ve generated, from which channels. You also can explain in simple terms what’s working, what’s not, and why. You don’t need a BI team to pull numbers.

Automation and tooling

You build workflows that save time. Email sequences, content distribution, lead scoring, social scheduling, speaker deadlines, meeting booking, post-event follow-up.

You use LLMs, no-code tools / light scripting to automate repetitive work.

You’re always looking for the next thing that should be a workflow instead of manual effort.

What we’re looking for

Must Have:

3 to 7 years in B2B marketing, ideally with some exposure to technical or industrial products
You’ve run B2B trade show or conference presence end to end at least twice: negotiated the space, briefed the stand builder, pre-booked the meetings, ran the floor, did the follow-up and reported the result
You’ve secured speaking slots through calls for papers or curated programmes, ideally with a customer on stage
You’ve run account-based outreach to a named list, with sales, and can show what it produced
Strong writing skills - you can explain complex technical value clearly and without jargon
Daily, fluent use of LLMs as real working tools, not "I use ChatGPT to brainstorm"
Comfortable updating a website in a CMS without help
Comfort with data: you set up tracking, read dashboards, and make decisions based on numbers
Self-direction: you don’t wait to be told what to do next
Comfortable with travel: you attend every event on the calendar, which means one trip almost every month, mostly in Europe, some long-haul.

Strong Plus:

You’ve run a customer advisory board, a customer roundtable programme or a reference programme
Website skills beyond the CMS: basic HTML/CSS, SEO fundamentals, and awareness of LLM optimization
Experience with automation tools (Make, Zapier, n8n) or basic scripting (Python, JavaScript)
Background in mobility/transport, IoT, or industrial tech
Experience marketing to enterprise buyers with long sales cycles
Design skills (Figma, Canva) for quick asset creation

What this is not

This is not a brand strategy role. It’s not a “manage agencies and review decks” role: you'll brief a stand builder, a film crew, a designer or a PR freelancer when the work needs them, and you'll do the rest yourself.

It’s not a role where you spend three months building a brand book before producing anything. You’ll be creating and shipping from week one.

It’s not a pure events role either. A stand only pays if the meetings were booked before the show, the case study on the table is good and the follow-up lands. The content, the website and the automation are what make the events work.

Why this is interesting

You'd own marketing entirely. No team inherited, no playbook to follow, at a company with real customers, real revenue, and a product that genuinely works. The case studies write themselves: 66% towing reduction, 25% spare fleet reduction, 20% fewer on-road breakdowns. The challenge isn’t inventing a story. It’s telling it well, to the right people, at the right time.

You’d have the autonomy to build the marketing function your way, with a leadership team that understands the value of modern, technical, AI-native marketing.

What we offer

Health Insurance to you and your children;
Fringe Benefits Policy (for Portugal located workers);
Flexible Work Hours - adjust your schedule to your needs;
22 vacation days, plus up to 3 extra time off days according to your tenure;
Work Setup - remote, hybrid, onsite - if your job can be done remotely, and you prefer to, you’re free to choose;
Hardware and software for a remote setup;
Quarterly Events to discuss Strategy;
Autonomy and Ownership Culture;
Continuous feedback culture;
Innovation Mindset;
Career Acceleration.

Location

Remote (Portugal) .

This role can be performed remotely, onsite, or on a hybrid setup in Coimbra, Portugal.

Regardless of the arrangement, availability to attend in-person meetings at our Coimbra office is expected when required. An average of once every two weeks should be expected. During onboarding expect it to be more regular to meet in person with the team and ramp up quickly into our operations.

What you can expect during the recruitment

Screening call with HR

Screening with HR

Interview with Hiring Manager (1h w/ HR and Hiring Manager)

We want to get to know you better and navigate through your experience, skills and motivation.

Work Simulation Live Exercise (1h w/ Hiring Manager and Job Role Stakeholders)

Context previous to the interview will be provided.

Expert Conversation (1h w/ Hiring Manager and an expert on this function)

A conversation about the role and how you would approach it, with a senior marketing or commercial leader who knows this kind of job from the inside.

Cultural Fit Interview (1h w/ Head of People and Founders)

Validate the cultural fit between you and Stratio and make sure you’re the person we’re looking for to help us build a #zerodowntimefuture.

Hiring Proposal
References may be required at any stage of the recruitment process.

AI & Transparency

We use AI-supported tools to help our team through the hiring process, here's how:

AI-assisted CV review: summarizes and suggests points for the hiring team to consider and help the team review applications faster; it does not make or influence hiring decisions.
Profile anonymization: your name, gender, and other personal identifiers are hidden during early screening to avoid bias.
Interview transcription: interviews may be recorded and transcribed to help our team focus on the conversation, with your consent.

Every decision about your application is made by a person from the hiring team. These tools assist our hiring team, they don't replace them.

About Stratio

Stratio delivers condition monitoring and predictive maintenance technology that powers a zero downtime future for transportation.

More than 1.3B people travel each year in vehicles using Stratio’s technology. The distance covered every day is remarkable, equal to 50 full journeys around the planet. Behind the scenes, more than 250 thousand maintenance predictions are generated daily, turning potential failures into planned interventions and keeping services running smoothly.

We want inspiring individuals in our teams, where age, race, gender, sexual orientation, politics and religion do not matter, and seek to create a tolerant and open space for everyone. We thrive to provide an inclusive and trustworthy environment.

You can find our Culture Manifesto and more team information here.

Take the road with us!

About Us:

BrandBastion transforms the way brands handle social engagement, working with some of the most recognized names in the world - Netflix, Uber, Sephora, Benefit Cosmetics, JD Sports and more. We help our partners get the most out of their social media engagement, across paid, organic, and non owned conversations. Our proprietary technology automates the management of millions of social interactions every day, while maintaining the personal quality of one-on-one conversations grounded in context, brand knowledge and TOV.

The Role:

BrandBastion is looking for a strategic, commercially minded Account Director with deep experience in organic social media, community engagement and enterprise client leadership.

This is not a paid media or campaign execution role. We need someone who understands what happens after content goes live, how brands manage communities, engage audiences, protect their reputation, deliver customer care and use social conversations to inform broader business decisions. And on top of that, understand that tooling and AI will make it possible.

You will own a portfolio of strategic accounts and be accountable for the overall customer relationship, account strategy, value realization, retention and growth. You must be comfortable acting as the primary senior partner to leaders such as Global Heads of Social, VPs of Marketing and Customer Experience executives.

Our product, technical and operational teams will support platform configuration, onboarding and workflow optimization. However, you will need to understand the platform, confidently advise customers on how to use it and take hands-on ownership of moving accounts forward.

What you'll own:

Take direct ownership of a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts, including customer outcomes, senior relationships, retention, renewals and expansion
Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across social media, marketing, brand, community and customer care
Develop a clear account strategy based on each customer's priorities, organizational structure and measures of success
Lead strategic conversations across organic social, community management, moderation, engagement, social customer care, sentiment and brand health
Connect BrandBastion's platform and services to measurable customer outcomes and business value
Lead executive business reviews that provide insights, recommendations and clear next steps
Identify adoption gaps and account risks early, then personally drive the plan to address them
Own commercial conversations related to renewals, expansion and additional BrandBastion solutions
Partner with product and technical specialists to improve workflows, platform adoption and customer results
Bring customers relevant social trends, industry knowledge, examples and strategic ideas
Maintain strong organization and follow-through across multiple complex accounts and stakeholder groups

Requirements

Experience as an Account Manager, Account Director, Client Partner, Social Strategist, Social Media Lead or senior customer leader
Experience working with large consumer brands through an agency, social technology company or in-house team
The credibility to lead a useful strategic conversation with a Global Head of Social or VP of Marketing
Strong knowledge of social strategy, community, engagement, moderation, customer care and campaign performance
A commercial mindset and experience with retention, renewals, growth or account expansion
Strong ownership, organization and follow-through
The ability to translate data and customer goals into clear recommendations
Comfort learning technology and partnering with technical specialists
A proactive, hands-on approach to managing and growing accounts

Benefits

At BrandBastion, high performers shape their own path. You'll have opportunities to:

Lead strategic initiatives that impact our Social AI-first approach
Advance into senior leadership roles based on performance
Work with global brands at the forefront of digital engagement
Be part of a fast-growing AI-first company leading the future of Social Engagement
Competitive Market Rate Compensation + 4+ weeks paid time off
Opportunities for global team meets
Flexible, Fully Remote Role: Enjoy the benefits of remote work while collaborating with a talented global team

With a bold vision for continued global growth, BON CHARGE is building a world-class team and this role is an integral part of our content and creative engine.

Role Overview

We’re seeking an organised and detail focused UGC Coordinator to support the sourcing and delivery of user generated content for BON CHARGE. You will find, vet, brief and manage UGC creators and review every piece of content they deliver for use across paid advertising, product pages and selected organic social channels.

This is an output driven role with a strong focus on content quality, brand and compliance alignment, and delivery volume. The role does not cover affiliate or paid influencer partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

Creator Sourcing & Vetting

Source UGC creators directly and via creator platforms (e.g. Insense or similar) across the wellness, biohacking, beauty, fitness and lifestyle niches
Vet creators for on-camera quality, audience fit, brand alignment and reliability before onboarding
Build and maintain a creator roster segmented by customer persona, product category and market (AU, US, UK, EU, CA)

Briefing & Creator Management

Write clear creator briefs covering product, persona, funnel stage, hooks, format, length and usage rights
Negotiate creator rates, deliverables and content licensing for paid, web and organic use
Manage product seeding, creator communication, deadlines and revisions end to end

Content Review & Quality Control

Review all delivered content against the brief, brand guidelines and product claim requirements before release
Coordinate claim and compliance checks with the Scientific Affairs and Compliance team
Manage revisions and reshoots, and ensure final files are named, tagged and stored in the UGC library

Delivery for Paid, Web & Organic

Deliver a monthly pipeline of UGC assets for paid media, including multiple hook variations per video, to the acquisition and performance marketing teams
Supply UGC assets for landing pages and product detail pages in partnership with the CRO and web teams
Provide selected UGC for organic social in partnership with the Social and Community team
Support with Community Management and comment replies across paid ads & organic social content.

Reporting & Collaboration

Track creator pipeline, output volume, cost per asset and turnaround times, and report weekly to the brand and marketing leads
Feed performance learnings from paid media back into creator selection and briefs
Stay current on UGC formats, platform trends and competitor creative

Requirements

1 to 3 years of experience in UGC, creator management, content production or social media (e-commerce, wellness or beauty industry preferred)
Experience sourcing and managing creators and reviewing content for paid advertising
Working knowledge of creator platforms (e.g. Insense, Billo or similar) and content usage rights
Strong eye for what performs on Meta, TikTok and YouTube, including hooks, formats and funnel stages
Highly organised and able to manage many creators, briefs and deadlines at once
Clear written communication, particularly for briefs and creator feedback
Familiarity with regulated product claims (wellness, health or beauty) is an advantage
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment

Why Join BON CHARGE?

Be part of a global wellness brand at a pivotal growth stage
Work alongside passionate founders and a supportive executive team that truly champions innovation and creativity
Join a team that genuinely values culture, fun and connection, where wellness is something we live and breathe every day

jobs.description:
Senior Creative Strategist (Remote - Anywhere)

About Us

Ancient Remedies is a fast-growing natural health and wellness brand on a mission to make the healing wisdom of nature accessible to people everywhere. We believe generations-old health knowledge deserves to be preserved, researched, and made practical for modern life—so we combine time-tested herbal wisdom with modern research through our books, guides, and wellness resources to help people make more informed health choices.

What started as a passion for natural healing has grown into a global brand serving hundreds of thousands of customers—and we're still building.

We're a remote, international, results-driven team that values ownership, speed, clear communication, and execution over bureaucracy.

At Ancient Remedies, you won't simply be filling a position. You'll have the opportunity to build, experiment, improve, and make a visible impact on a company that's continuing to grow.

The Role

As a Senior Creative Strategist, you'll turn performance data and market research into scroll-stopping ad concepts—headlines, hooks, and scripts—that ship across Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube. You'll work closely with media buyers, designers, and copywriters to test and iterate fast, always chasing what performs over what just looks good.

What You Will Own

Find useful insights in customer reviews, support feedback, past ads and competitor research. Separate what the evidence shows from what you still need to test.
Build distinct angles and hooks for paid social, with a clear audience, promise, reason to believe and test hypothesis.
Write direct-response scripts and briefs that an editor can use. Explain the opening visual, story, pacing and call to action.
Help choose what to test and what to change. Read results with media buyers, including spend, audience, conversion, refunds and contribution margin.
Turn both wins and losses into specific next steps. Know when to improve an execution, test a new angle or stop an idea.
Give useful feedback, share what you learn and help raise the team’s standard. Strong work can look different from your own style.
Use AI and research tools well. Check their output, protect source material and take responsibility for the final work.

What Strong Candidates Bring

Hands-on experience creating direct-response video ads for paid acquisition, with examples of scripts or briefs you personally shaped.
Evidence that you can repeat good work across more than one concept or campaign. You can explain your part in the result and the limits of the data.
Strong written English for customer-facing copy. You can make a complex idea easy to understand without inventing facts or making unsupported health claims.
Sound commercial judgment. You understand why a high click rate or a headline ROAS figure alone may not mean a profitable ad.
Clear briefs, reliable follow-through and a useful response to feedback. You can work across a remote team and raise blockers early.

Experience with health and wellness audiences, older consumers, Meta video ads or other paid video channels is useful. We care most about the work and how you think.

What Success Looks Like

In your first month
, you’ll learn our audience, products and review process, ship your first approved briefs and explain the thinking behind them.

By the end of your first three months
, you’ll own a clear cycle of research, concepts, production feedback and test learnings. We’ll review the quality of your decisions, how you work with the team and the commercial results of work that received a fair test. Your lead will set clear goals and review them with you throughout this period.

Why Join Us

Competitive salary - Benchmarked to market rate with regular reviews as we grow.
Performance bonuses - Your results are recognized and rewarded. We celebrate people who move the needle.
Fully remote - Work from wherever you do your best thinking. No commute, no compromise.
Flexible hours - Async-friendly and autonomy-driven. We care about output, not when you’re online.
22 days PTO - 22 days paid holiday plus 4 paid sick days — no questions asked.
WFH equipment budget - One-time budget to get your home office set up with the IT equipment you need from day one.
Learning budget - Annual allowance for courses, books, and anything that helps you grow.
Real ownership - At 100 people, your work has direct impact. No bureaucracy, no waiting for permission.
A team that cares - Genuinely warm, highly productive people who show up for each other as much as for the work.
Room to grow - We’re scaling fast. The role you start in today can grow into something much bigger tomorrow.
Monthly Performance-based Creative Bonuses.

How To Apply

Send your CV or profile and two examples of paid-ad work. For each, tell us what you personally did, what happened and what you’d improve. Use anonymized work or a clear written case if client confidentiality limits what you can share. Do not send confidential account access or data you don’t have permission to disclose.
Our process is:
a short application,
a recruiter prescreen,
a five-minute walkthrough showcasing your work
conversation, and one focused discussion about your work.

We’re hiring mainly at Senior level. We may consider a strong Associate where the scope fits, using the same practical assessment and a clearly stated level and pay range.

Please note:
Although the job posting is listed in Germany, this is a fully remote position and we're open to candidates from anywhere.

If you’re ready to grow fast, ship relentless creative, and see your words drive millions in revenue, we want to meet you.

All applications will be treated strictly confidential.

Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Nuestra cultura y nuestras personas son el motor de WPP Media, y nos impulsan a ofrecer experiencias excepcionales. En este rol, tu contribución será clave para vivir y promover nuestros valores:

Ser Extraordinario: Liderando colectivamente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora.
Ser Abierto: Equilibrando las experiencias de las personas y los clientes, cultivando la confianza.
Ser Optimista: Impulsando el crecimiento y el desarrollo para movilizar a toda la empresa.

Tu rol y contribución

Actualmente, desde nuestro equipo de Relevance
buscamos un/a Creative Director
que impulse la diferenciación de nuestra agencia en el mercado, la retención de clientes y la generación de negocio a través de un liderazgo creativo excepcional.

En este rol, tendrás la oportunidad de:

Desarrollar e implementar estrategias creativas alineadas con los objetivos de negocio del cliente y el enfoque distintivo de nuestra agencia.
Elevar la calidad de las propuestas creativas en todas las cuentas, asegurando que nuestro trabajo supere los estándares de la industria.
Liderar, mentorizar e inspirar a un equipo creativo multidisciplinar en áreas como Motion, Producción y Brand Experience.
Establecer y optimizar procesos y flujos de trabajo creativos para maximizar la productividad y la excelencia.
Actuar como socio creativo para los clientes, construyendo relaciones de confianza y demostrando el valor de nuestras soluciones.
Fomentar una cultura de creatividad, colaboración y excelencia dentro del estudio y la organización.
Impulsar la adopción de nuevos enfoques, tecnologías y metodologías creativas para mantener nuestra oferta a la vanguardia.

¿Qué buscamos en ti?

Sólida experiencia liderando y desarrollando equipos creativos multidisciplinares en un entorno de agencia.
Experiencia demostrable en el desarrollo e implementación de estrategias creativas que generen un impacto medible en el negocio.
Experiencia en la gestión de relaciones con grandes clientes y en la presentación de propuestas creativas de alto nivel.
Profundo conocimiento de las últimas tendencias, tecnologías y metodologías en el ámbito creativo y de medios.
Visión de negocio para identificar oportunidades de crecimiento y fortalecer la relación con los clientes.
Capacidad para establecer y optimizar procesos y flujos de trabajo creativos que garanticen la excelencia.
Formación superior en Publicidad, Diseño, Comunicación o campos relacionados.

Vida en WPP Media y beneficios

En WPP Media, invertimos en nuestra gente, impulsando tu crecimiento profesional con la misma pasión con la que lideramos la inversión responsable en medios. Formar parte de nuestro equipo significa acceder a una red global de conocimiento y oportunidades, donde podrás expandir tus horizontes y estar siempre a la vanguardia del sector. Además de un entorno de trabajo dinámico y desafiante, en WPP Media nos preocupamos por tu bienestar y equilibrio. Por ello, ofrecemos un paquete de beneficios pensado para ti:

jobs.title: Founding Creative Director
jobs.description:
Meet Siena

Siena is the The Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

The role

Siena is building the intelligence layer for CX, and we're about to launch several products in quick succession. We are not looking for someone to execute a brief well. We are looking for the person whose taste the rest of the company gets measured against: someone who looks at a landing page and can't not have an opinion, who would rather kill a launch than ship something mediocre, and who has owned creative direction before, not just contributed to it.

If you need a creative director above you setting the vision, a team to delegate to on day one, or a slow, considered, one-project-at-a-time pace, stop reading now. This isn't that job.

If you're the person other designers already defer to on taste, continue.

This is a craft title. Not a headcount title.

You will ship personally for the first year and set the bar for everyone who comes after. Over time you will build a small internal agency, two to three people across design, motion, and content, that can brief, position, and launch without outside help.

Narrative and positioning across every launch - design as strategy, not decoration
Every artifact that goes to market: landing pages, launch video, decks, social
The design system, from v3 onward
The bar, full stop - if it ships under the Siena name, you made it or you signed off on it

What it takes to be in the room

Taste, above everything, and evidence you can defend it. Specific, defended opinions about what's good and why.
A track record of owning creative direction, not just contributing to it. Agency or in-house, brand refresh or full launch - you've been the person whose call was final, not the one waiting on notes.
Narrative thinking. Design as positioning. You should already have a point of view on how a brand like Siena should be positioned, not just how it should look.
AI as a working tool, not a threat to your taste. You've already built something with AI - an app, a prototype, a mockup - and you want to get technical enough to ship a landing page yourself within a year. Anti-AI is disqualifying.
Range that travels. Your background doesn't have to be SaaS. Fashion, art, consumer brand, editorial - what matters is whether your taste holds up somewhere new.
A pattern of shipping in chaos, not around it. Multiple launches in flight, feedback that moves in hours not weeks. If your best work happens on a slow, protected timeline, that's useful information - it's just not this role.

Why this is worth it

You're not joining a design team to fit into. You're setting the taste bar for a company that's about to be a lot more visible, a lot faster than most companies get that chance.

This is intense - real ownership, real launches, a founder team that reviews your work directly and moves at the pace you'd expect from that. It's also one of the rare creative seats where nothing you make gets diluted by committee before it ships.

If that sounds like the room you've been trying to get into, we want to talk to you.

If it sounds like too much scrutiny too fast, this isn't a knock on you - it just isn't this role.

Why Siena?

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.
Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.
A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.
A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.
Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.
Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.
AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback—both giving and receiving it—because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

Our approach to AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we’re not just looking for people who can do a job. We’re looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that’s you, we look forward to your application.

We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human-only review at talent@siena.cx.

jobs.title: Head of AI Operations
jobs.description:
Our Mission

We're not your average benefits platform – we're the driving force that uplifts people's lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Head of AI Operations
, you own Ben's internal applied AI transformation: reinventing how the whole company works, function by function, so the business runs on a new operating system. You'll work directly with the founders, with the backing, budget and authority to make it a reality.

It's a once-in-a-lifetime role. Where most people get one team and a backlog, you get the whole company as your canvas, from customer operations to commercial, finance and people. You find the work that's slow, manual and held together with duct tape, and you rebuild it so it runs itself. Piece by piece, that becomes the way Ben operates.

There's no better place to do it. Ben's whole mission is to make things work at their best, and we already do that in benefits for thousands of companies. Now we're doing it to ourselves, and you're the one who leads it.

Things you'll be working on

Rebuild the company operating system: partner with customer operations, finance, people and commercial to find what's slow, manual and held together with duct tape, and redesign it so it runs seamlessly.
Reinvent how work happens: get hands-on with each function to design and stand up the systems that take on whole workflows end to end, then drive them across the company. A new customer going from signed contract to fully live in days, work that eats weeks today. The customer team looking after twice the number of accounts without anything slipping. The kind of leverage that changes what a company our size can do.
Own the Applied AI strategy: work with the founders to shape where Ben goes next on applied AI, what we change, in what order, and how we know it's working. Engineering owns how AI goes into the product. You own how AI transforms the way we run internally.
Drive adoption and bring people with you: help every function become genuinely AI-native. Raise the bar for how teams work day to day, so the change sticks and the systems actually get used.
Set the standard and prove it works: own the standards, guardrails and quality bar for how Ben adopts AI, and put real evals in place so we know a system works before we trust it with live work, and that it keeps working. Keep us on the right side of compliance as agents start touching customer, people and finance data. This is how what ships gets trusted and used, instead of half-finished pilots piling up.

You'll love this role if you have/are...

High-growth B2B SaaS experience, and evidence you've driven this kind of change: you've operated at pace in a high growth, scaling SaaS business, and you can show how you've shifted the way teams actually work, with the outcomes to back it up.
A strong systems thinker: you think about the bigger picture, and have owned complex problems that cut across different parts of a business.
Deep, practical AI fluency: you use tools like Claude, Claude Code and other AI tooling every day. You've got strong, well-formed views on where they create real value and where they don't, and you can turn that into adoption that sticks across a business.
Exec-level influence in a scaling company: you can carry a room from ICs to the C-suite, challenge leaders well, and turn ambiguity into aligned action.
A bias for getting your hands dirty: you don't lead change from a distance. You get inside how a function really works, redesign it, and work with teams proactively to drive change. You've built things people assumed needed a whole team, and you can show us what and the why.
A force multiplier: You create repeatable systems, lift and develop the people around you, and know when to coach, co-build, push or escalate.

Nice to have(s)

Prompt and context engineering: you have a structured approach to getting the best out of models, and have experience teaching others to do the same.
Have built the guardrails: you've set the bar for what an internal AI system is trusted to do, and put real evals behind it, so you know it works before it goes near live data.

Why join us?

This is one of the most important hires we'll make at Ben, and one of the rare roles where a single person can change how an entire company works.

A canvas most people never get: your remit is the whole company, starting with our biggest and most complex operation, how we deliver for customers.
A real mandate: you work directly with the founders, with the budget, the tools and the backing to take work off entire teams and change how Ben runs.
You'll be at the frontier: the market hasn't even settled on a name for this role yet. Do it well and you write the playbook everyone else copies in a couple of years.
The most impactful work of your career: Ben helps hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries get the benefits and support they need. Make our functions work better and that reaches every one of them.

Our Compensation & Benefits

It’s important to us to practise what we preach when it comes to our benefits. We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package. This means you have a choice over the things that are most important to you. You can see a selection below, along with the full offering here.

and workplace nursery scheme

Diversity and Culture at Ben

jobs.title: Senior Project Lead - Cost Optimization Initiative
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Save the Children International has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Project Lead – Cost Optimization Initiative
to join our global team
.

Team and Role Purpose

Save the Children is launching the Cost Optimisation Initiative to improve organizational sustainability, strengthen value for money, and maximize resources available for children and programme delivery. The aim is to build a simpler, smarter, and more efficient Save the Children that delivers greater impact for children through better use of every resource entrusted to us.

Role purpose

The Senior Project Lead –Cost Optimisation will lead a high-profile, enterprise-wide transformation initiative aimed at designing cost optimisation and delivering 30–40% structural cost efficiency by 2030 while protecting program quality, organizational resilience, and beneficiary impact.

The role will provide strategic and operational leadership to a complex, multi-year transformation program spanning Global teams and Country Offices across all support functions. The Senior Project Lead will be responsible for driving alignment across senior stakeholders, leading organizational redesign efforts, identifying sustainable efficiency opportunities, and ensuring successful implementation of transformation initiatives in a highly matrixed environment.

The Senior Project Lead will also champion innovation, digital enablement, and AI-driven operational intelligence to modernize ways of working, simplify processes, improve decision-making, and enable scalable operational efficiency across the organization.

Job Title: Senior Project Lead – Cost Optimization Initiative
Reports To: Director, SCI-Led Funding & CO Efficiency
Work Pattern: Hybrid/Remote with flexible working options available
Location:Any approved Save the Children International office location. For a full list of locations that Save the Children International can hire in, please visit: SCI Careers
Required Time Zone: Any
Contract Length: Fixed Term Contract (18 Months (until 31 Dec 2027)
Right to Work: The successful candidate must have the right to work in the country where the role is based, for the duration of employment.
Language Requirements: English
International Travel: up to 10%
People Management: Number of people managed in total: 4; Manager of a team: Yes; Team Manager (manager of multiple teams): Yes
Remit: Global

Principal Accountabilities

Lead the Cost Optimisation Project and Organisational Adoption: lead the design, planning, and delivery of the Cost Optimisation Project, ensuring alignment with strategic, operational, and financial objectives and develop and maintain a phased, multi-year transformation roadmap with prioritised initiatives, clear milestones, and alignment to organisational delivery capacity
Lead Change Management and Continuous Improvement: Drive organisational change, stakeholder adoption, and continuous improvement for the Cost Optimisation initiative to embed sustainable efficiencies and a culture of operational excellence.
Identify and Deliver Efficiency Opportunities: Drive the identification, prioritisation, and implementation of enterprise-wide efficiency opportunities across all support functions and organisational levels.
Drive Cost Optimisation and Benefits Realisation: Establish cost baselines, analyse current and future state, and ensure delivery, tracking, validation, and sustainability of efficiency benefits and cost savings including structured reporting to senior stakeholders.
Enhance efficiency in Service Delivery: Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise, and optimise service delivery models and levels of effort across functions and geographies.
Lead Programme Governance and Delivery: Establish programme governance structures, oversee workstreams, manage dependencies, and ensure timely delivery of agreed milestones and outcomes.
Influence and Engage Senior Stakeholders: Facilitate alignment, decision-making, and collaboration across senior stakeholders, functions, and geographies to support successful delivery.
Leverage AI, Digital Solutions, and Analytics: Promote the use of AI, automation, analytics, and digital technologies to improve operational efficiency, decision-making, and organisational effectiveness.
Manage Programme Risks and Organisational Change: Proactively manage programme risks, issues, and organisational impacts while ensuring effective change management and adoption of new ways of working.
Embed a Culture of Continuous Improvement: Foster innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement, ensuring efficiency initiatives are embedded into long-term organisational practices and governance.

Essential

Experience and Skills

An extensive track record of leading large-scale organisational transformation, organisational redesign, and enterprise-wide change programmes within complex global organisations.
Significant experience operating within complex INGOs, federated organisations, multinational matrix environments, or similarly complex stakeholder structures.
A proven ability to design and implement enterprise-wide organisational redesign initiatives across both programmatic and support functions, including operating model transformation and service delivery redesign.
A proven ability to apply excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, and to work collaboratively to deliver of effective solutions to project related issues. This will include taking on hands on analysis activities to support the wider team as required
Extensive experience engaging, influencing, and building alignment among Executive Leadership Teams, Global Functional Leaders, Country Directors, Member organisations, and senior stakeholders across multiple geographies.
A proven ability to lead and influence in highly ambiguous, politically sensitive, and rapidly changing environments, including influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
Strong knowledge and practical experience of operating model design, shared services, process harmonisation, workforce and level-of-effort optimisation, finance transformation, and organisational effectiveness initiatives.
Exceptional executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management capability.
Experience leveraging AI, automation, analytics, and digital transformation approaches to improve organizational performance.

Desirable

Experience leading global transformation programs exceeding USD 100M operational scope.
Experience working across both headquarters/global teams and decentralized country operations.
Experience supporting ERP transformation Initiatives.
Experience in Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement, or operational excellence methodologies.
Exposure to enterprise analytics, AI-enabled transformation, or intelligent automation initiatives.

Essential

Education and Qualifications

Master’s degree in business administration, Finance, Organizational Development, Strategy, Operations, Management, or related field.

Desirable

Professional certification in Programme Management, Change Management, Lean Six Sigma, Organizational Design, or related discipline is strongly preferred.

Working at Save the Children International

Save the Children is the world's leading organisation for children, employing ~25,000 staff. We save children's lives. We fight for their rights. We help them fulfil their potential. Through our work in 116 countries, we put the most deprived and marginalised children first.

We know that great people make a great organisation, and that our employees play a crucial role in helping us achieve our ambitions for children. We value our people and offer a meaningful and rewarding career, along with a collaborative and inclusive environment where ambition, creativity, and integrity are highly valued.

The work here is challenging but is also immensely rewarding. At Save the Children, you will be in good company, working with talented, like-minded individuals who are determined to ensure that all children survive, learn, and are protected. Your contribution will help ensure children's voices are heard at the highest levels, and that we achieve our global strategy, Ambition for Children 2030
, and reach every last child.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and Equal Opportunities

DEI is core to our vision, values and global strategy. Save the Children is committed to creating a truly diverse, equitable and inclusive organisation, and one which will support us in our vision to ensure every child attains the right to survival, protection, development, and participation.

We are committed to equal employment opportunities, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, colour, ethnic origin, nationality, disability, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, pregnancy and maternity, caring or parental responsibilities, age, or beliefs and religion. We are committed to diversifying our staff to better represent the communities we serve and actively welcome underrepresented groups to apply.

Reasonable adjustments will be made should any candidate invited to interview require this.

Application Information

Please attach a copy of your CV and cover letter with your application. A full copy of the role profile can be found at SCI Careers . It is recommended that you save a copy of the role profile as it will no longer be available after the advert closes.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and the job advert may be closed earlier than advertised subject to the volume of suitable applicants. Please submit your application at your earliest convenience to avoid disappointment.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Candidates who are successfully shortlisted should expect to hear from us within 2 weeks of the advert deadline.

Our Recruitment Process

Application review by our recruiting team based on your CV and cover letter
Two-stage competency-based interviews with the hiring team
Some recruitment may include an additional assessment or case study stage, or a third stage interview
If successful, you will receive a conditional offer of employment, followed by your contract subject to passing background checks

We need to keep children and adults safe so our selection process includes rigorous background checks and reflects our commitment to the protection of children and adults from abuse. All employees are expected to carry out their duties in accordance with our Code of Conduct and all policies and procedures relating to Anti-Harassment, Health and Safety, Safeguarding, and DEI and Equal Opportunities.

Save the Children does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruitment process.

Blankstate is a London deeptech company. We build a model that lets people and organisations experience a decision before they commit to it. For several years we have done that in stealth with major regulated institutions, including financial services, across four continents.

We are now coming into public view, including a first product anyone can enter. We are a lean, senior team. This role is for the person who builds how the world comes to know us, not someone who sits inside a big marketing machine.

The role

You own how Blankstate shows up: the narrative, the content, the community forming around us, and the day-to-day relationship with the partners and agency taking us to market.

AI and tooling are leverage here, not the job. You set the direction; our in-house solution engineers support the automations and tools needed, and our Art Director owns the visual system.

🎯 What You Will Own

Two fronts you run hands-on, day to day:

Content. Produce the content that carries Blankstate: posts, short-form video, launch moments, campaign copy, thought-leadership. Augmented so you move fast, made within the visual system our Art Director owns
Community. Stand up and grow the community forming around us: structure, onboarding, rituals, and the loop that carries what people tell us back inside. Year one is about strong foundations, not an overnight crowd, and it is yours to build

Operations and Execution:

Brand visibility (GEO and SEO). Once the tracking is plugged in, you read the dashboard, see where we stand, and call the next move. Own how Blankstate shows up when people ask an AI assistant about us (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Grok), alongside classic SEO
The website and owned channels. Light-touch through our straightforward backoffice, on an editorial calendar you own
One story, everywhere. Keep everyone inside speaking the same language about who we are. Meetings and notes run on automation, so your time goes to deciding, not documenting

Requirements

2 to 5 years in content, brand, or digital marketing, ideally in tech or a startup, and ready to step up into an ownership seat
A critical thinker with taste. You can find the story, judge what is genuinely good, and decide what deserves attention. This matters to us as much as raw output
Someone who thinks ahead and executes. You plan a step or two out, then make it happen. You use state-of-the-art AI fluently in your own work, with a good instinct for what is worth automating
A strong writer and content-maker with a good eye. You do not need to be a designer, but you can produce clean content within a visual system and turn a brief into something that lands
Comfortable with numbers. You want to know if what you shipped moved anything, and you report the insight, not the vanity metric
Curious about the AI discovery layer. You either already track how brands appear in AI answers, or you are ready to own that discipline (GEO). It is a core focus of the role and one of the fastest-growing areas in marketing
Location: London. In-office at our Moorgate HQ as the default, with flexibility when needed
Language: fluent English. Portuguese is a bonus (we work closely with Brazil), not a requirement

Benefits

What we offer

Base salary of £40,000 - £75,000 annually (dependent on experience)
Pension and standard UK benefits
Own the first public story of a company whose work is already live inside major institutions
Real ownership and a genuine growth path. This seat is built to grow into higher management seat, and further, on merit and timing
A senior, collaborative team, an Art Director alongside you, and a PR agency behind you
Vested access to the company EMI / ESOP share scheme after trial

Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben.
Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm
). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet
.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Du willst in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen Europas mit überzeugenden Creatives dazu beitragen, die Brücke zwischen klinischer Forschung und überzeugenden Botschaften für Patientinnen zu schlagen? Dich treibt die Frage um, warum bestimmte Gesundheitsbotschaften wirken, und du bist bereit, Ownership für die Insights und Prozesse zu übernehmen, die unsere gesamte Creative-Pipeline optimieren? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Wir suchen ab sofort einen Creative Strategist (w/m/d) für Kijimea. Du wirst Teil eines Teams, das Klarheit, Wissenschaft und Kundenverhalten konsequent in den Mittelpunkt stellt. Gemeinsam erschließen wir neue Wachstumschancen, indem wir kreative Konzepte systematisch testen und unsere Position als vertrauenswürdigste, datengetriebene Marke in der Kategorie Verdauungsgesundheit weiter ausbauen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du führst quantitative sowie qualitative Markt- und Zielgruppenanalysen durch, um Präferenzen, Motive und Bedürfnisse der Zielgruppen fundiert zu verstehen.
Du schreibst Direct-Response-Skripte für den Bereich Video-Content und nutzt dabei Storytelling-Elemente, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erzeugen und überzeugend zu argumentieren.
Du erstellst klare, datenbasierte Briefings für unsere Agenturpartner, damit überzeugender Content entsteht
Du tauchst tief in Performance-Daten ein und identifizierst, warum ein Creative gewonnen oder verloren hat – ob Hook, medizinischer Claim oder visuelles Format – und spielst die Learnings direkt in die Produktion zu-rück.
Du bringst proaktiv Ideen ein, die unsere Online-Kampagnenziele unterstützen und sich stringent in die Gesamtstrategie einfügen.

Dein Profil

Du hast ein Studium oder eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung z.B. im Bereich Kommunikationswissenschaften, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Journalismus oder Marketing.
Du konntest bereits mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrungen im Bereich Creative Strategy sammeln (idealerweise in einer Agentur oder in einem Start-/Scale-up) und möchtest deine Skills nun bei einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare Player weltweit einbringen und weiter ausbauen.
Du verstehst, dass Content auf Plattformen wie Meta oder Youtube ein entscheidender Performance Treiber ist und brennst dafür, neue Formate und Angles zu entwickeln und zu testen
Du arbeitest datenbasiert und gehst analytisch ins Detail; seien es kommerzielle KPI wie ROAS oder CPO, oder auch Klick-, Hook- oder Engagement Rates
Du arbeitest äußerst strukturiert, sorgfältig und zuverlässig.
Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Level) und gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2-Level).

Unser Versprechen

Wir bieten Dir einen vielfältigen, anspruchsvollen Job mit spannenden Aufgaben und einem breiten Spektrum an Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten! Unser innovatives Umfeld ermöglicht Dir Deine berufliche Entfaltung mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, Verantwortung von Tag 1 an und den Freiraum, neue Wege zu gehen. jobs.description:
About SCRL

SCRL is one of Sweden's most successful tech companies. We build creative tools used by 7 million monthly active creators around the world. By combining design, technology, and a deep understanding of how people create content, we're shaping the future of social media design.
We've done it without raising venture capital or chasing headlines. Instead, we've focused on creating products people genuinely love and building a company with ambitious, thoughtful people who care deeply about their craft.

The role

We are looking for a full-time freelance Creative Producer
to run localized ad production in the Southern EU region (France, Italy, Spain).

Your day-to-day

Take concepts that already perform and make them land in your market:
Translate and adapt in-ad copy from English into French, Italian and Spanish (hooks, on-screen text, captions, VO scripts), rewriting it for the market rather than translating word for word.
Produce ads for Meta: swapping text captions, stills, a-rolls and export finished, spec-correct assets from our templates.
Source your own raw material from UGC content creators: create briefs and handle the process from outreach to delivery.
Experience optimizing creatives based on performance data.
Conduct research on local trends, personas, messaging, barriers, triggers and competitor mapping.
Create your own hypotheses for creative concepts.
Stay updated on the latest AI-creative production tools & trends, and use them where they save real time.

Who We’re Looking For

Several years of experience in a creative or social media role in-house or freelance, as a Strategist, Producer, or Copywriter, ideally at an advertising agency, app, or SaaS company.
Deep knowledge of trends and social media landscape in the Southern EU countries, to be able to adapt concepts to look genuinely native.
Based in France, Italy or Spain.
Native speaker of French, Italian or Spanish, plus working proficiency in English. You'll write natively for your own market and oversee adapted copy for the other two, so knowledge of those languages is a strong plus.
Experience with creating content for paid social with a clear focus on performance (CTR, CPA, ROAS).
Hands-on editing skills in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (After Effects / Premiere especially).
Experience with UGC & Influencer briefing and management.
Strong ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines with little supervision.
Clear communicator, capable of walking teammates and stakeholders through your thinking.
A strong sense of what good looks like — you can tell quality, well-crafted content, and your own work reflects it.

Why SCRL

We care deeply about doing things well and working with people who feel the same way.
Your work will be seen by millions of people worldwide
Real ownership and visible impact in a small team
One product, built with care
Self-funded, long-term focused, quality-driven team

If this sounds like the kind of place where you’d enjoy doing your best work, we’d love to hear from you.
We’re a growing team based in central Stockholm, working closely across disciplines to build products people love. We care deeply about craft, collaboration and creating a place where everyone can learn and grow.
Please submit your application in English.

En Lognext llevamos más de 18 años acompañando a empresas y equipos para identificar e implementar la tecnología necesaria para avanzar, haciendo nuestros sus retos y objetivos y acercándonos a su realidad.

Ser parte de NETTER significa que tu carrera y tu talento adquieren significado para ti y para quienes te rodean, lo que te permite construir lo que más te importa y alcanzar tu siguiente nivel.

Se trata de un puesto práctico de ingeniería de plataformas centrado en la administración, operación y evolución de entornos Kubernetes en producción . Buscamos a alguien que comprenda Kubernetes más allá de la implementación de aplicaciones y que se sienta cómodo trabajando a nivel de clúster, plano de control, nodo, red e infraestructura .

• Automatice el aprovisionamiento, la configuración y las tareas operativas de la infraestructura utilizando Ansible, Terraform, Helm y Bash/Python , reduciendo la intervención manual y mejorando la coherencia de la plataforma.

• Sólido conocimiento de la arquitectura de Kubernetes y sus componentes principales, incluyendo kube-apiserver, etcd, kube-scheduler, controller-manager, kubelet y nodos de trabajo .

• Experiencia con la programación de Kubernetes y la ubicación de cargas de trabajo utilizando etiquetas, nodeSelector, afinidad/antiafinidad y taints/tolerations .

• Experiencia en la resolución de problemas de Kubernetes a nivel de plataforma, incluyendo fallos de nodos, cargas de trabajo pendientes/en bucle, redes, limitaciones de recursos e incidentes a nivel de clúster .

• Experiencia con conceptos de redes de Kubernetes como CNI, Ingress/Egress, balanceadores de carga, NetworkPolicy y conectividad de servicios .

• Experiencia con conceptos de almacenamiento persistente de Kubernetes, como volúmenes persistentes, solicitudes de volumen persistente, clases de almacenamiento y controladores CSI .

• Experiencia práctica con Ansible y Terraform para la automatización de la infraestructura y la configuración.

• Experiencia con soluciones de monitorización y observabilidad como Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, OpenTelemetry, Splunk o similares .

• Experiencia práctica con Red Hat OpenShift 3.x/4.x , incluyendo administración, actualizaciones y resolución de problemas.

• Conocimiento de proyectos, rutas y operadores de OpenShift, así como de Red Hat CoreOS .

• Experiencia en la gestión de nodos OpenShift a través de MachineConfig y MachineConfigPool , incluyendo cambios de configuración a nivel del sistema operativo, como redes, SSH o NTP.

• Experiencia en la creación o participación directa en la implementación de clústeres de Kubernetes desde cero .

• Experiencia con herramientas de CI/CD y GitOps como Jenkins, GitLab, Bitbucket, GitHub Actions o Argo CD .

jobs.title: Principal Solutions Consultant - Zeta Marketing Platform
jobs.description:
Zeta helps enterprise brands connect customer data, intelligence and activation to create better customer experiences and measurable growth.
Our Solutions Consulting team brings that proposition to life. We are trusted advisors working at the intersection of sales, technology and customer strategy, helping customers understand what is possible and how to achieve it.
We partner closely with Enterprise Sales, Customer Growth, Product, Engineering and Services to translate complex business challenges into differentiated solutions. Through strategic discovery, compelling demonstrations and practical solution design, we help leading brands transform how they engage with their customers.
You will join a collaborative team that values industry expertise, knowledge-sharing and a “win together” mentality.
About the Role

As a Principal Solutions Consultant, you will lead solution and technical strategy for some of Zeta’s most strategic enterprise opportunities across the UK, supporting both new customer acquisition and growth within existing customer relationships.
With a core focus on Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), you will help enterprise brands connect their customer engagement ambitions with practical technology solutions. You will shape opportunities across the wider Zeta portfolio, including platform modernisation, migration and expansion.
Reporting to the Director of Solutions Consulting, you will partner closely with Enterprise Sales, Customer Growth and cross-functional teams to understand complex customer challenges, develop differentiated solution strategies and demonstrate measurable business value.
This is a senior individual contributor role combining executive engagement with hands-on technical leadership. You will personally lead discovery, develop tailored demonstrations and guide technical evaluations, while acting as a mentor, enablement leader and senior technical voice within the Solutions Consulting organisation.
What You’ll Do

Lead strategic discovery and solution design.
Own discovery and solution strategy for complex enterprise opportunities, partnering with Enterprise Sales and Customer Growth to understand business objectives, technical requirements and success criteria.
Advise senior decision-makers.
Facilitate executive workshops and technical strategy sessions with marketing, data and technology leaders, connecting customer engagement and transformation priorities to clear business outcomes.
Shape enterprise solutions.
Design solutions centred on ZMP and the wider Zeta portfolio, spanning customer engagement, customer data platforms, identity, analytics, personalisation, AI and cross-channel orchestration.
Build and deliver compelling demonstrations.
Personally develop tailored demonstrations and coordinated multi-product narratives that make complex technology clear, relevant and differentiated.
Own technical win strategies.
Develop and execute technical win plans alongside commercial teams, supporting complex requests for proposal (RFPs), competitive evaluations, proof-of-concepts and technical validation exercises.
Support customer growth and modernisation.
Identify how customers can realise greater value through additional capabilities, broader adoption and platform evolution, helping define practical migration and expansion paths.
Validate feasibility and delivery requirements.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Services and implementation teams to clarify data, integration, architecture and migration dependencies, and ensure a clear handover from pre-sales into delivery.
Represent capabilities accurately.
Ensure proposed solutions reflect functionality available in the relevant market, clearly distinguishing current capabilities from roadmap items and making delivery dependencies explicit.
Bring customer insight into the business.
Translate customer requirements, competitive insight and market feedback into recommendations that inform product priorities and UK go-to-market strategy.
Elevate the wider team.
Mentor Senior Solutions Consultants and Solutions Consultants, and contribute to pre-sales methodologies, standards, playbooks and enablement programmes.
Represent Zeta externally.
Share expertise through customer events, conferences, webinars and other industry engagements.

What You’ll Bring

10+ years of experience
in Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering or enterprise pre-sales within SaaS, MarTech, CRM or related technology platforms.
Demonstrated success supporting and winning complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise opportunities, with strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how technical differentiation supports both acquisition and customer growth.
Deep understanding of enterprise Customer Engagement Platforms (CEP)
, customer data platforms (CDP), identity, data, analytics, AI-driven personalisation and cross-channel orchestration.
Strong executive presence and credibility with CMOs, CTOs, CIOs and other senior business and technology leaders.
The ability to connect customer business priorities with technology capabilities and articulate a clear, credible transformation vision.
Excellent discovery, workshop facilitation, presentation and executive storytelling skills, alongside hands-on experience developing tailored demonstrations and supporting technical evaluations.
Experience developing and executing technical win strategies, navigating enterprise architecture discussions and working through complex integration and data requirements.
A collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively across Sales, Customer Growth, Product, Engineering, Services and customer teams.
The ability to mentor and elevate colleagues without formal people-management responsibility.
A strategic mindset combined with the willingness and capability to work hands-on within active enterprise opportunities.

Why Join Us

You will play a central role in shaping how Zeta brings its platform and capabilities to market across the UK, working on some of our most important and complex enterprise opportunities.
This is an opportunity to help leading brands rethink how they use customer data, intelligence, AI and activation, combining executive influence with practical technical problem-solving and meaningful commercial impact.
You will also help strengthen the Solutions Consulting organisation through mentoring, enablement and shared expertise, while contributing directly to Zeta’s product and go-to-market evolution.
Location & Flexibility

This role is based in London, with a hybrid working model and regular presence in Zeta’s London office. Travel across the UK will be required to support strategic opportunities, customer workshops, executive meetings and industry events.
PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA

Job Description

We are in search of an Enterprise Customer Success Manager (CSM) with a focus on data to engage and retain some of Pluralsight’s largest customers and help them achieve their desired business outcomes. This role requires a consultative approach with a strong focus on value, and a proven track record of collaborating with large-scale customers to develop their strategies and showcase Pluralsight’s impact on their success. A successful CSM builds outstanding relationships, drives data driven insights, is customer centric and shows skill at achieving trusted adviser and advocate status in the customers’ minds. You will work cross-functionally to drive strategic partnerships with a focus on regular customer communications (Running QBRs, EBRs, On-site visits, consulting customer on engagement campaigns) to drive positive results and renewals/expansion.

Who You’re Committed To Being

A customer obsessed individual partnering optimally with customers across industries to reach their business goals.
Persuasive, committed & results driven with demonstrable experience in driving action & advancing strategy in large customers.
Laser-focused on demonstrating customer value & driving customer health through regular strategic engagements with existing collaborators & able to expand stakeholder map.
A standout colleague, able to handle ambiguity, anticipate and react to changes in a constantly evolving environment. Driven by helping others and contributing positively to the team.
Ability to listen, think logically, strategically, and tactically to tackle sophisticated problems.
Self-motivated, demonstrating an ability to assume responsibility and work autonomously

What You’ll Do

Understand customer needs and strategic priorities.
Proactively mitigate risk throughout the customer life cycle and ultimately position your accounts for continued growth.
Effectively lead activities such as: Regular customer engagements, Quarterly Business Reviews (which are rooted in business knowledge & data driven), Executive Business Engagements, Success Planning & Value led conversations to drive skill and tech strategy advancement.
Build strategic relationships at the C-Level and are comfortable being the authority in the room through demonstrable consultative skills to work and partner effectively with key customer stakeholders.
Develop and share standard processes with team members to continually improve the quality, effectiveness, and efficiency of our processes.
Meet and exceed quarterly renewal rates and renewal upsell rate, or other targets defined by the business.

Experience You’ll Bring

Ability to perform a value-led discovery with customers, to uncover their business objectives, key priorities and desired outcomes.
Deep understanding of a successful customer success motion.
Proven experience in a Customer Success, account management, or client-facing role, with a track record of driving platform adoption and customer outcomes
A genuine interest in how people learn and develop, and experience working alongside L&D, HR, or talent teams either in a previous role or as part of your current one
The ability to operate credibly at executive level, comfortable leading a skills strategy conversation with a CTO or CHRO without it feeling like a vendor pitch
Data fluency: the ability to take a Skill IQ trend, an MAU chart, and a licence utilisation report and build a narrative that changes how a customer thinks about their investment
Commercial curiosity: a genuine interest in whether the customer's business is succeeding, and the instinct to connect learning outcomes to business outcomes
Organized and capable of highly effective time management.
Ability to operate in a fast-paced professional environment.

Requirements

Experience as one of the following:

CSM or account managers from HR tech, LMS, or learning platform businesses, who already understand the L&D buyer and the language of skills development
Customer Success professionals who have spent time embedded in customer L&D or HR programmes, running enablement, onboarding, or learning initiatives
Former L&D professionals who have moved into commercial or customer-facing roles and want to combine both skillsets in one place
Sales engineers or solutions consultants from the learning or talent space, ready to move into a longer-term, relationship-led role
Hybrid Work Model: This role follows a hybrid schedule, with on-site work at our Dublin, Ireland office Wednesday and Thursday and remote flexibility on Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays. This approach helps us collaborate more effectively, make decisions more quickly, and build a stronger culture, while still providing flexibility.
Travel: Travel expectations differ by role. Some quota-bearing sales positions involve limited travel, while others may involve travel of up to 40%, depending on business needs.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

We’re a blended workplace, where team members work remotely or in a hybrid setup depending on their role and location
We’re mission driven and guided by our culture pillars
We have a strong commitment to diversity and belonging
We cultivate a culture of trust, autonomy, and collaboration
We’re lifelong learners and champion team member growth and advancement
We’ve got you covered - team member benefits include competitive compensation packages, medical coverage, unlimited PTO, wellness reimbursements, Pluralsight subscription, professional development funds and more.

About Us

Pluralsight provides the only learning platform dedicated to accelerating the technology skills and capabilities of today’s tech workforce. Thousands of companies, government organizations and individuals around the world rely on Pluralsight to support critical technology skill development in areas that are crucial to innovation including artificial intelligence, cloud computing, cybersecurity, software development, and machine learning. Pluralsight provides highly curated content developed by vetted technology experts, industry leading skill assessments, and hands on, immersive learning experiences designed to help individuals skill-up faster.

Physical Requirements

This role is primarily performed in an office or home office setting and involves standard computer-based work.
